# Defensive

A mobile-first tower defense game. Plain HTML/CSS/JS + canvas, no build step.

- **Play:** open `index.html` (or the GitHub Pages URL once Pages is enabled on `main`).
- **Balance numbers:** all in `js/config.js`.
- **Balance check (optional):** `node tools/sim.js` lets bots play runs headlessly and prints which wave they reach.
- **Project rules and code map:** see `CLAUDE.md`.

hotelwhyfy/ScratchesRedux.desc: native port of the SCream engine used by the 2006 point-and-click PC game, Scratches with widescreen support
hotelwhyfy/ScratchesRedux.readme:
# SCream Redux

A reimplementation of the SCream engine used by *Scratches* (2006) and
*Scratches – Director's Cut* (2007). It runs the **original, unmodified game
scripts and data**: the compiled Lua scripts build the world through the
engine's `sc*` API, which this project reimplements in C++20 with SDL3 and
OpenGL. Behaviour comes from the scripts and from disassembling the original
`scream.exe`, not from guesswork; all 87 API functions are ported
(`scream --api-status` lists them).

![The opening view: Blackwood Manor at dawn, from the garden](docs/screenshot.png)

*The Director's Cut's opening view, running in SCream Redux. The game's art is
© Nucleosys; it is shown here only to illustrate the engine.*

No game data is included. You need your own copy of the game.

## Status

Both releases are playable from start to finish: the Director's Cut (both
campaigns, the main game and The Last Visit) and the original 2006 release. The
automated player (`--explore`) plays each of them through to its ending.

Ported from the original:

- **World:** cube-map panoramas with the original camera, hotspots and close-ups.
- **Media:** Theora cutscenes; Vorbis sound, music (including surround tracks)
  and voices; subtitles.
- **Text:** feedback, subtitles, choices and the journal in the original's layout
  and monospaced font.
- **Screens:** the inventory with its tutorial hints, the journal, and the main
  and setup menus.
- **Effects:** the original's crossfades, gamma correction, sky, fog, rain,
  night, lightning and candlelight.
- **Controls:** the keyboard shortcuts, slideshow mode and alternate control.
- **Settings and saves:** `scream.cfg`, and saved games in the original file
  format.

The 2006 release's Lua 5.0 scripts are translated to Lua 5.1 as they load. When
it runs, the engine behaves as the 2006 executable did:

- its field of view and vertical look range
- 800×600 layout, so text wraps at about 70 characters
- an inventory 8 icons wide
- its menu
- generated clouds

See [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) for the reverse-engineering notes (with addresses in
`scream.exe`) and [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md) for the project's state and workflow.

## Building

Requires CMake 3.24+, a C++20 compiler and SDL3 (`brew install sdl3` on macOS).
Lua 5.1.5, stb, libogg and libtheora are vendored in `third_party/` (see each `SOURCE.txt`).

```sh
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo
cmake --build build -j
```

## Game data

Unpack the installers (see NOTES.md; `unar` handles the NSIS installers and the
split 7z) so you have directories containing `scream.sc`, `scratches.sc`,
`scream.cfg` and the `.res` archives. For the updated Director's Cut:

```sh
./build/scream --data extracted/dc/install --data extracted/dc/update
```

Later `--data` directories override earlier ones, so the disc 2 update's
`scratches.sc` and `update.res` (HD textures) take precedence. For the 2006
release (scripts and `scream.res` from the installer, `scratches.res` from the disc):

```sh
./build/scream --data extracted/2006/install --data extracted/2006/disc
```

## Configuration: `scream.cfg`

The game's own `scream.cfg` (found in the data directories) is read the way the
original reads it, and every key takes effect:

| key | effect |
|---|---|
| SCRIPT | the game script (`SCRIPT.sc`, else `SCRIPT.lua`) |
| WIDTH, HEIGHT | the screen mode: the size of the window and the scale of every on-screen layout (the DC ships 1024×768, the 2006 release 800×600) |
| FULLSCREEN | start fullscreen (the mode is scaled to your display) |
| QUALITY | 0 gives nearest-pixel textures |
| VSYNC | 1 syncs to the display |
| SURROUND | also play the rear-channel music files |
| LOG | write `scream.log` in the save folder (the L key toggles it) |
| PATH, RESOURCE, LANGUAGE | as in the original |
| DEPTH, RATE, AUDIO_DEVICE, BUFFER_SIZE, NUM_BUFFERS, DEBUG | read, but they only affected Windows display and OpenAL setup |

The shipped files ask for fullscreen. Pass `--windowed` (or `--window WxH`) to
run in a window.

**Setup launcher.** Rather than editing the file by hand, open the setup window:
start with `--setup`, hold Option (macOS) or Alt (Windows) while the game starts,
or, on macOS, choose *Settings…* (⌘,) in the application menu while playing,
which opens it in a separate window next to the game. It edits the game's own
`scream.cfg` in place, keeping its comments, and keeps the shipped file as
`scream.cfg.orig` the first time you save. *reset* brings the shipped values back.
Click a setting (right-click to go back), or use the arrow keys and Return. It
also has this port's one addition to the file, `WIDESCREEN`: when it's on,
panoramas fill a window wider than 4:3; when it's off, they keep the original's
4:3 with black sides, like everything else. The original's own parser skips the
key, so the file still works with the original game. A running game notices
when the file is saved and applies the changes within a second: screen mode,
fullscreen, widescreen, vertical sync, textures and the log file at once,
surround music from the next track.

## Playing

Mouse:

- **Look around.** The Director's Cut starts with *alternate control* on: the
  view follows the mouse and the cursor stays in the middle. Turn it off in
  Setup to look around by moving the mouse to the screen edges instead, the
  2006 release's only mode. In *slideshow mode* (Setup), clicking an edge turns
  the view a step instead.
- **Interact.** Left-click.
- **Inventory.** Right-click opens and closes it. Left-click an item to pick it
  up, then left-click where to use it.

Keys, as `scream.exe` maps them:

| key | action |
|---|---|
| A / Left | turn left |
| D / Up | turn right |
| W / Right | look up |
| S / Down | look down |
| E / Space | look straight ahead |
| F1 | hints |
| F2 | surround music |
| F5 / F7 | quicksave / quickload |
| F9 / F10 | camera speed / text speed |
| F12 | gamma |
| L | log file on or off |

Esc closes the inventory, journal or overlay, or ope

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Original menu layout; alternate control (fixed mouse movement)

Menu, from scream.exe's renderer 0x408550, click handler 0x413640, hit test
0x417c90 and prompts 0x412fa0: the logo and vertically stacked buttons with
greyed load/save and an additive hover; load/save/setup lists with the

springs back a tenth of the way per frame and the cursor is drawn at the

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Run the 2006 release: translate its Lua 5.0 bytecode to 5.1 at load

The 2006 scripts are Lua 5.0 chunks. src/lua50.cpp rewrites each chunk into
the 5.1 format as it is loaded: the function layout, instruction field
positions, RK constant encoding and opcode numbers (5.0 TEST is 5.1 TESTSET;
5.0 numeric for loops get room for 5.1's FORLOOP), vararg functions in 5.1's
compatibility mode. Generic for loops and table constructors over 32 items
are rejected; the shipped scripts use neither.

The 2006 game plays through to its finale under --explore and crawls clean.

Also: HANDOFF.md brought up to date (state, test tools, Ghidra project path,
gotchas, open items); tools/watch_explore.sh watches an --explore run.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Full-width transitions, SC_SCREEN_COLOR, scGet as in scream.exe, fullscreen menu bar

- The crossfade capture covers the whole window width, as the 3D view does;
  on a widescreen window the sides used to cut to the new view while only
  the 4:3 middle faded.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Rooms remember the last node; bind slots and failed binds as in scream.exe

- Switching to a node stores it in the room (0x415bd2, room+0xdd8), so
  re-entering a room returns to where the player left it; scSetLastVisited
  overrides it. We used to re-enter at the first node.
- scBind(SC_ROOM) and scSwitch(SC_ROOM) leave the node and zoom slots bound
  (one slot per kind): putLetter's changeTime ends with scBind(SC_ROOM), then
  binds inside_mailbox in the mailbox zoom.
- A failed scBind(SC_OBJECT) unbinds the object (scream.exe binds index 0,
  and using it is fatal there); scEnable/scDisable on nothing log a warning
  instead of changing the previously bound object.

Explorer: learns moves made by using an item on a hotspot (lighting the
passage candelabra leads to n2) and replays them on routes; once-only hints
apply to item use too; warns about actions done 1000 times (learned doors
excepted).

Both campaigns play through to their finale with no engine warnings.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Binding a room, node or zoom leaves the bound object bound

scream.exe keeps one bind slot per kind (0x49dd0c[kind]; 0x402ce0 writes
only that slot, 0x402b40 only range-checks), so scBind and scSwitch of a
room, node or zoom don't unbind the object. grabTooth relies on it: its
changeTime() binds nodes and the room before scDisable(SC_OBJECT); with the
object unbound the tooth could be taken forever, an hour each time.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Bind one object at a time; scLock released by view switches; explorer upgrades

Engine:
- One object is bound at a time, as in scream.exe (0x402ce0 binds a single
  index): scBind(SC_OBJECT) takes the first object of that name in the view,
  a click binds the clicked object, and scEnable/scDisable and the builder
  calls change only that object. Disabling every same-named hotspot made the
  greenhouse shovel (and the ending) unreachable: n7 has two "hose" hotspots.
- Every frame capture for a transition releases scLock (0x48bc0c), which
  phone-call branches rely on; the cutscene-end capture doesn't.

Explorer (--explore):
- Progress state leaves out navigation and presentation (last visited nodes,
  textures, effect flags, last picked option).
- Never-done actions first, backtracking through recorded transitions, zoom
  stack aware routes, global zoom lookup, same-named hotspots kept apart,
  learned scripted doors updated or forgotten, choices reopened while options
  remain, stall detection and a detailed stuck report.
- --explore-hints FILE: clue puzzle solutions, scratch globals, once-only
  hotspots (kept out of the repository).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Explorer; zooms are found globally in creation order

--explore plays a campaign automatically with player actions only and

It showed that scream.exe finds zooms by name across all rooms (first

--turbo runs without audio or video and with fast game time; --crawl

westernbear/GuessingGame.readme:
# 다섯고개 카카오톡 챗봇

봇이 매일 단어 하나를 정하고(꼬맨틀 방식, KST 기준 `#n`), 사용자는 예/아니오 질문으로 맞힙니다. 질문 답변과 정답 판정은 [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/docs/zen)의 무료 **Jev 1.13**(`jev-1.13-free`, System One `noul` 질문)이 합니다. 1:1 채팅과 그룹방(팀채팅) 다인 플레이를 지원합니다.

- `시작` / `시작 10`: 오늘 문제 시작 (기본 5고개, 1~20)
- 아무 질문: 예 / 아니오 / 글쎄요, 질문 하나당 한 고개
- `포기`, `도움말`
- 그룹방은 방 전체가 한 게임과 고개를 공유하고, 먼저 맞힌 사람이 이깁니다. 하루 한 문제라 끝난 뒤에는 다음 날까지 다시 시작할 수 없습니다.

## 실행

```sh
npm install
SKILL_SECRET=<비밀> PORT=8080 npm start   # POST /skill
ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV=1 PORT=8080 npm start  # 로컬 개발: 비밀 없이 아무 호출이나 받음
npm test            # 게임 로직 테스트
npm run check       # 타입 체크
```

Node 23.6 이상이 필요합니다(`.ts`를 직접 실행). 런타임 의존성은 없습니다.

| 환경변수 | 기본값 | 설명 |
|---|---|---|
| `SKILL_SECRET` | (없음) | `x-skill-secret` 헤더가 같은 요청만 받습니다. 필수이며, 비어 있으면 서버가 시작하지 않습니다 |
| `ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV` | (없음) | `1`이면 `SKILL_SECRET` 없이 시작해 아무 호출이나 받습니다. 로컬 개발 전용, 공개 배포에 쓰지 마세요 |
| `JEV_MODEL` | `jev-1.13-free` | 유료 `jev-1.13`을 쓰려면 바꾸고 키를 넣습니다 |
| `OPENCODE_API_KEY` | (없음) | 있으면 `Authorization: Bearer`로 보냅니다 |
| `JEV_URL` | `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/systemone` | 다른 System One 호환 엔드포인트(예: TypeSafe `https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone`) |

> ⚠️ Zen 무료 등급은 "OpenCode 안에서만 사용"을 조건으로 합니다. chat/completions 엔드포인트는 실제로 외부 호출을 거부합니다. `systemone`은 현재 키 없이 응답하지만 언제든 막힐 수 있습니다. 실서비스에서는 `JEV_MODEL=jev-1.13`과 `OPENCODE_API_KEY`를 쓰세요. 게임 상태는 메모리에만 있어서, 재시작하면 진행 중인 게임이 사라집니다.

## Docker

```sh
cp .env.example .env        # SKILL_SECRET 등을 채운다
docker compose up -d --build                    # 127.0.0.1:${KBOT_PORT:-8080}
docker compose --profile tunnel up -d --build   # + Cloudflare Tunnel (TUNNEL_TOKEN 필요)
```

`main`에 푸시하면 GitHub Actions(`.github/workflows/image.yml`)가 테스트 후 `ghcr.io/westernbear/guessinggame`에 `latest`와 `sha-<커밋>` 태그로 이미지를 올립니다(`v*` 태그는 버전 태그). 서버에서는 `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`로 빌드 없이 받아 쓸 수 있습니다.

컨테이너는 non-root(`node`) 사용자로, 읽기 전용 파일시스템과 `cap_drop: ALL` 상태에서 실행합니다. 포트는 로컬에만 열어 두니, 외부 공개는 터널이나 리버스 프록시로 합니다. 터널을 쓸 때는 Cloudflare Zero Trust에서 public hostname(예: `kbot.westernbear.dev`)의 서비스를 `http://kbot:8080`으로 지정합니다.

## 1:1 챗봇 연결 (카카오 i 오픈빌더)

1. [챗봇 관리자센터](https://chatbot.kakao.com)에서 봇을 만들고 카카오톡 채널을 연결합니다.
2. **스킬**에 `https://<서버>/skill`을 등록하고, 헤더값에 `x-skill-secret: <SKILL_SECRET 값>`을 넣습니다.
3. **폴백 블록**의 응답을 이 스킬로 설정합니다. 그러면 모든 발화가 서버로 옵니다.
4. 배포합니다.

## 그룹 챗봇 연결 (일반채팅·팀채팅, Beta)

그룹 챗봇은 **카카오 제휴 심사**를 통과해야 만들 수 있습니다. 관리자센터 > 내 챗봇 > 그룹 챗봇 탭의 `신청하기`로 제안합니다(문의: chatbot@kakaocorp.com). 2026-10 기준 일반채팅(나와의 채팅 제외)과 팀채팅에서 동작합니다. 입점 기준은 유용한 정보, 그룹방 사용성, 서비스 안정성이고, 특정 방 전용·CS·단순 홍보 봇은 대상이 아닙니다.

1. 운영 채널과 **별도의 개발 채널**을 만들어 연결합니다. 개발 채널 봇은 테스트용 팀채팅방 1개에서만 동작합니다.
2. 1:1과 같은 `/skill`을 폴백 블록에 연결합니다. 서버는 `userRequest.chat.properties.botGroupKey`로 방을 구분합니다.
3. **봇 설명**을 14자 이내로 씁니다(예: `매일 다섯고개 퀴즈`). 팀채팅 봇 목록과 검색에 이 설명이 노출됩니다. **채널 공개**도 켭니다.
4. **봇 입장 블록**에 짧은 환영 문구와 "챗봇 멘션하기" 버튼을, **도움말 블록**에 규칙을 넣습니다.
5. 팀채팅방에서 봇을 추가한 뒤 `@봇이름 시작`으로 플레이합니다. 멘션이 없는 메시지는 봇에게 전달되지 않습니다. 카드 버튼을 누르면 멘션이 자동으로 붙습니다.

그룹방에서는 quickReplies가 표시되지 않아서, 응답은 모두 textCard 버튼으로 보냅니다.

tkalva2-source/XE-Widgets.readme:
# XE Widgets Touch-friendly Twitch chat and a now-playing audio visualizer for the **Corsair Xeneon Edge** (iCUE 5 HTML widgets). A vibe-coded fork by **Tkalva**: XE Chat started as a rework of the Lumo chat widget, and XE Visualizer and its companion server grew out of QuadraKev's QK XE Visualizer. Both were rebuilt from the ground up for speed, touch and a cleaner look on the Edge.

| Widget | What it does | |---|---| | **XE Chat** | Twitch chat with 7TV / BTTV / FFZ emotes, 7TV name paints and badges, stream info, chatting and moderation once you sign in, your followed channels (live first), and a live stream preview with sound and a theater view. | | **XE Visualizer** | Audio visualizer with the current song or video, album art, playback controls and themes. Works with Spotify, YouTube, Twitch and anything else Windows shows as "now playing". | ## Screenshots

XE Chat at the Edge's 841×697 size: chat · stream preview · theater view · settings menu. XE Visualizer at 840×344. Demo data, with made-up chatters and stream.

Both widgets talk to a small companion server that runs in your system tray. It relays Twitch chat (iCUE's browser can't reach Twitch directly), reads what's playing, captures audio for the visualizer and decodes the stream preview. ## Install 1. **Server** — download **[XE-Widgets-Server.exe](https://github.com/tkalva2-source/XE-Widgets/releases/latest/download/XE-Widgets-Server.exe)** and run it. It shows exactly what it will do and asks before installing. No Python or admin rights needed. 2. **Widgets** — download **[XE-Chat.icuewidget](https://github.com/tkalva2-source/XE-Widgets/releases/latest/download/XE-Chat.icuewidget)** and/or **[XE-Visualizer.icuewidget](https://github.com/tkalva2-source/XE-Widgets/releases/latest/download/XE-Visualizer.icuewidget)** and double-click them to add them to iCUE. 3. Add the widgets to your Xeneon Edge in iCUE. > **"Windows protected your PC"?** The server isn't code-signed (that costs money), so SmartScreen may warn on first run. Click *More info → Run anyway*. You can check the download against the SHA256 hash listed on the release, or build it yourself from this repo (see below). To update, run a newer `XE-Widgets-Server.exe`; it replaces the old one. > iCUE's own settings page shows a small preview of each widget that doesn't match the real layout. Adjust XE Chat with the settings button on the widget itself. ## What the server installs Running `XE-Widgets-Server.exe` asks first, then: - copies itself to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\XEWidgets\XE-Widgets-Server.exe` (your user folder only, no admin rights), - adds one startup entry (`HKCU\...\Run\XE Widgets Server`) so it starts with Windows — toggle it from the tray icon, - runs in the system tray. While running it: - **only listens on your own PC** (`localhost:16329`), nothing is reachable from the network, - connects to Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ and ivr.fi for chat, emotes, badges and stream info, - reads the "now playing" info Windows already shows (song, video, thumbnail) and captures audio for the visualizer, - decodes the stream preview when you turn it on. It collects nothing and sends nothing anywhere else. **Uninstall:** right-click the tray icon → *Uninstall…* (removes the program and its startup entry), then remove the widgets in iCUE. ## Signing in to Twitch (optional) **Good news first: you don't need to sign in to use XE Chat.** Reading chat, emotes, 7TV paints, stream info and the stream preview all work straight away, no account needed. Signing in is only for when you want to **type in chat, use moderation tools, or see the channels you follow**. It's a one-time setup that takes about 2 minutes, and you never have to do it again. ### Why do I need to make a "Twitch app"? Twitch only lets programs sign you in if they've been registered with Twitch. Instead of everyone sharing one registration, XE Chat lets you use your **own** free one. That means: - it's yours: nobody else's app ever touches your account, - there's nothing to pay and nothing to publish, - your password never goes anywhere near the widget (you approve the sign-in on Twitch's own website). Don't worry about the word "developer" below. You're not writing any code, just filling in a short form. ### Step by step 1. **Open the Twitch developer console**: go to [dev.twitch.tv/console](https://dev.twitch.tv/console) and log in with your normal Twitch account. - The first time, Twitch may ask you to turn on two-factor authentication (2FA) before you can register an app. That's a Twitch rule; follow its prompts and come back. 2. Click **Register Your A

# Animal in My Mind

An iPad-first web app for the guessing game "Animal in My Mind", and a fact-learning app for a young reader. Every answer is meant to be technically correct, including the surprising ones (moose swim, platypuses lay eggs). No backend, no accounts, no external links. Works offline once loaded.

## Screens

- **Title**: the title picture. Tap anywhere or tap Start.
- **Home**: two big buttons, read aloud when tapped. Also a sound on/off button and Photo credits (for grown-ups).
- **I'm thinking of an animal** (reference page while being quizzed)
  - Pick an animal from the photo grid, or tap **Pick for me**.
  - The animal card shows 11 clue tiles plus a fun fact: kind, body covering, legs and other limbs, fly, swim, where it lives, where in the world, what it eats, size, colours and special features. Tap a tile to hear the answer.
  - A question counter (+ and −) keeps track of the other player's questions.
  - **They guessed it!** reveals the animal with a celebration. This is the only time its name is read aloud.
  - **New Animal** picks another at random; every animal comes up once before any repeat.
- **I'm guessing**
  - **Hint**: tap once for a question-type picture, again for a full question (read aloud), again for the next type. Types rotate so every kind of question comes up.
  - **Animal ideas**: the photo grid; tap one to see its card.
  - **Play with the app**: the app picks a secret animal. Ask questions by tapping a question picture, then a question; the app answers Yes, No or About the same, and keeps a list. Tap **My guess** to choose an animal, or **Give up** to see the answer.

The thinking-mode card never reads the animal's name aloud, so the person guessing can't overhear it. Clue tiles and fun facts use "It..." sentences.

## Put it on the iPad

1. Open the GitHub Pages link in Safari.
2. Tap Share, then **Add to Home Screen**.
3. Open it from the home screen. It runs full screen and works without internet after the first visit.

If there is no sound, check the iPad volume and that Silent Mode is off.

### Keep him in the app (Guided Access)

1. On the iPad, go to Settings, Accessibility, Guided Access, and turn it on. Set a passcode.
2. Open the app, then triple-click the top button (or the Home button on older iPads) and tap Start.
3. To leave, triple-click again and enter the passcode.

## Animal data

All animals are in `js/animals.js`, one line each, with the allowed values listed at the top of the file. Hint and Play questions are built from this data, so a new habitat, colour or feature shows up automatically once animals use it.

To add an animal: add a line, add a picture named after its `id` in `images/animals/`, add a photo file name to `PHOTOS`, then run `python3 tools/make_sw.py` so the offline copy picks up the new files.

## Pictures

The cartoon drawings are placeholders. `GEMINI-IMAGES.md` has a style prompt and one line per animal for making matching pictures in Gemini, and how to switch the app over to them.

## Photos

Photos are listed in `PHOTOS` near the bottom of `js/animals.js` as Wikimedia Commons file names. To change one, find a better photo on commons.wikimedia.org, copy its file name (without "File:") and paste it in. The Photo credits screen fetches each photographer's name and licence from Commons, and flags any file name it can't find.

Photos load from Wikimedia, so they need internet the first time. After that the app keeps a copy for offline use. If a photo can't load, the drawing shows instead.

## Publish on GitHub Pages

Push this folder to a GitHub repository, then in the repository go to Settings, Pages, and set the source to the `main` branch, root folder. The site appears at `https://<username>.github.io/<repository>/`.

## Credits

Typeface: Andika by SIL International, designed for early readers (SIL Open Font License, see `fonts/OFL-LICENSE.txt`). Animal drawings and icons are original SVG artwork made for this app. Title art supplied by Pete. Animal photos are from Wikimedia Commons; photographers and licences are listed in the app under Photo credits.

Warthewolf/ac8survivalmod.readme:
# AC8 Survival Mode

A round-based survival mode for **Ace Combat 8** (PC). Waves of enemy fighters grow bigger and sharper every round,
bombers raid Comona Airport, and special rounds bring bosses and set pieces. Between rounds you land at the airport
and spend the zollars you've earned on missiles, special weapons, flares, repairs and airfield defences.

Unofficial fan mod by **voidcallsreaper**. Issues and feedback: `@voidcallsreaper` on Discord.

## Features
- **Rounds that escalate:** more enemies each round, with pilots ranked from Rookie up to Reaper, and difficulty
  spikes along the way.
- **Named ace squadrons:** from round 16, each with its own airframes and callsigns.
- **Bomber raids:** they go for the airfield. Its health, repairs, and the AA guns and SAM sites you can build
  all matter.
- **The landing STORE:** buy ammunition, repairs and airfield defences between rounds.
- **Special rounds:**
  - **Comona Defense:** protect the EMBDIR shuttle through its countdown.
  - **The Anomaly:** MINDRIPPER and the control-inverting field.
  - **Amphibious Assault:** landing craft and BTRs heading for the runway.
  - **The Ladons:** KOT and MISHKA.
  - **The Alicorn:** the submarine carrier.
  - **AB.L..IN:** IFF: FATAL ERROR.
- **Difficulty presets** (Casual / Standard / Ace) and an editable `survival.ini`.
- **Optional Discord leaderboard:** `leaderboard/` holds a Cloudflare Worker.

## Playing it
Download a release zip and follow the `README.txt` inside it. You'll need UE4SS for Ace Combat 8 and the AC8 Mod
Loader. `release/README.txt` is the player guide that goes into every zip.

## Repository layout
| Path | What's there |
| --- | --- |
| `mod/UE4SS/AC8SurvivalMode/Scripts/main.lua` | The mod's runtime: rounds, the STORE, HUD, special rounds, leaderboard |
| `mod/UE4SS/AC8SurvivalMode/Scripts/ai/` | Survival's enemy behaviour scripts |
| `mod/UE4SS/AC8SurvivalMode/config/survival.default.ini` | Player settings (copied to `survival.ini` on first run) |
| `runtime/survival_rt.c` | The native UE4SS mod in plain C (menu hook, spawner, ammo, events, music, leaderboard upload) |
| `tools/build_survival.py`, `tools/survival_events.py` | Build Survival's game packages and event package from the game's own files |
| `tools/build_all.sh`, `tools/package_test.sh` | Build everything; make a release zip with test-only code stripped |
| `tools/re/` | Reverse-engineering notes on the game's systems |
| `leaderboard/` | The Discord leaderboard (Cloudflare Worker + D1) |
| `AGENTS.md`, `SURVIVAL_SPEC.md`, `BUILD_PLAN.md`, `MISSION_REFERENCE.md` | Project rules, the agreed design, the plan, the stock-mission reference |

## Building
See `tools/README.md`. In short: Python 3.8+, LLVM (clang + lld-link) for the native runtime, retoc and Oodle for
packing, and your own copy of the game. The build extracts what it needs from your game files into `build/stock/`
(never committed). Then:

```sh
tools/build_all.sh            # build/install/: the mod, ready to copy into the game
tools/package_test.sh 0.57.1  # build/release/: a release zip
```

No game assets are in this repository.

## Licence
All rights reserved; see `LICENSE`. The code is published for reference: please ask before reusing any of it.

ACE COMBAT is a trademark of Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc. This project isn't affiliated with or endorsed by
Bandai Namco.

adgsenpai/nvme-power-tune.desc: Ubuntu NVMe tuning for MSI Cyborg 15 / Micron 2500: APST off on AC, readahead, benchmarks
adgsenpai/nvme-power-tune.readme:
# nvme-power-tune

NVMe tuning for an MSI Cyborg 15 B13WFKG (i7-13620H) running Ubuntu 26.04, with a
**Micron 2500 512GB** (MTFDKBA512QGN, DRAM-less QLC) behind Intel VMD,
LUKS2 → LVM → ext4.

- **On AC:** NVMe APST is turned off and the power profile is set to `performance`.
- **On battery:** the kernel's original APST table is restored and the profile is set to `balanced`.
- **Always:** readahead on the root logical volume is 1 MiB.

It runs at boot, whenever you plug in or unplug, and after resume.

CPU/GPU tuning for the same laptop lives in a separate repo:
[cyborg15-cpu-gpu-tune](https://github.com/adgsenpai/cyborg15-cpu-gpu-tune).

## Install / remove

```bash
./install.sh          # LV=vg/lv ./install.sh  to target another volume
./uninstall.sh
journalctl -t nvme-power-tune     # see what was applied
```

To stop it from changing the power profile, set `SWITCH_PROFILE=0` in
`/usr/local/sbin/nvme-power-tune`.

## Findings

All raw-device tests were read-only (`fio --readonly`). Every temporary change was reverted afterwards.

| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| PCIe | 16 GT/s x4. Reading a nearly empty region gives **6,748 MiB/s**, so the link, VMD and controller are fine. |
| Real data, sequential 1M | ~2.2–2.4 GiB/s. The limit is the 512GB QLC flash (few NAND dies). Rated 6,600 MB/s is best-case. |
| LUKS (aes-xts-512, VAES) | ~0% cost. Raw and decrypted reads match. `no_read/write_workqueue` already set. |
| LVM + ext4 | ~0–5% |
| Thermal | 43 °C idle, 57 °C after sustained reads. Zero T1/T2 throttle events. |
| HMB | Enabled, 64 MB |
| io_uring vs libaio, QD, scheduler | No meaningful difference. `none` kept. |
| ASPM | Controlled by the BIOS under VMD. Runtime policy change is refused. |

## Experiments (one change at a time)

| Change | Effect | Kept |
|---|---|---|
| APST off | 4K read after idle: 5–16 ms avg with 30–38 ms spikes → ~1.4 ms steady | on AC |
| Readahead 128 → 1024 KB | Buffered seq ~1.1 → ~2.0–2.4 GiB/s | yes |
| PS3-only APST table | ~2.3 ms avg, ~14 ms max after idle | optional (see below) |
| CPU latency QoS 0 µs | No gain; lower throughput | no |
| mq-deadline vs none | Within noise | no |

### Optional battery compromise

Booting with `nvme_core.default_ps_max_latency_us=5500` keeps the shallow PS3
state on battery but drops the deep PS4 state (30 ms exit latency). Test it once
by pressing `e` at the GRUB menu before adding it to `/etc/default/grub`.

## Benchmark

`tools/bench.sh LABEL` reports: sequential 1M read, 4K QD1 latency, 4K latency
after 250 ms idle, and buffered read speed. It only reads.

## Benchmark: stock vs tuned (back-to-back, on AC)

| Test | Stock | Tuned | Gain |
|---|---|---|---|
| Buffered reads (game loading, file copies) | 1,062 MiB/s | **2,233 MiB/s** | **2.1×** |
| First 4K read after idle, average | 7.0 ms | **1.6 ms** | **4.5×** |
| First 4K read after idle, worst case | 33.2 ms | **1.8 ms** | **18×** |
| Raw sequential 1M (direct) | 2,183 MiB/s | 2,270 MiB/s | flash-limited |

Tbone94/keyhaven.desc: Keyhaven: a pixel-art typing roguelike that teaches kids English touch typing and vocabulary
Tbone94/keyhaven.readme:
# Keyhaven: a typing adventure

A pixel-art **typing roguelike with a town-building meta layer**. It teaches **English touch typing and English vocabulary** to kids. It's built for Korean students, with an English UI by default and a 한국어 toggle.

## Hosting

**The easy way:** upload `dist/keyhaven.html`. It's one self-contained file (about 245 KB) with no external requests, so school content filters have nothing to block.

**Embed it in a page:**

```html
<iframe src="/games/keyhaven.html" width="960" height="600"
        style="border:0;max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10" allow="autoplay"></iframe>
```

The game scales itself to any size. Kids click once to give the game keyboard focus.

**URL options** (optional, for teachers or the host page):

| Param | Example | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `lang` | `?lang=ko` | Korean UI (default is English) |
| `age` | `?age=0` | 0 = grades 1–3, 1 = grades 4–6, 2 = middle school+ |
| `realm` | `?realm=6` | Unlock up to that realm (lesson focus for a class) |
| `session` | `?session=15` | Class timer: shows a "session complete" break after a run ends at 15 min |
| `calm` | `?calm=1` | Monsters never attack (for absolute beginners) |
| `music`, `speak` | `?music=1&speak=0` | Background music on, read-aloud off |

## How it teaches (research-based)

- **Key order:** 21 realms. Each adds two mirrored keys: F J → D K → S L → A ; → G H → review → E I → R U → T Y → W O → Q P → review → V M → C , → N B → X . → Z / → review → Shift → ? ' ! → numbers. This follows the Dance Mat / Mavis Beacon / 한컴타자 style. Each new key pair gets a short guided lesson from Professor Hoot.
- **Accuracy first:**
  - Stop-on-error: a wrong key never deletes progress, and Backspace does nothing.
  - Accuracy counts first tries only.
  - The next realm unlocks only when the boss is beaten at the grade's accuracy target: 90%, 93% or 95%.
  - Coins are multiplied by accuracy, not speed.
- **Adaptive speed:** monsters walk at about 75% of the child's own measured typing rhythm. They slow down after mistakes, after two losses in a row, and on a first visit to a realm.
- **Hints that fade:** the on-screen keyboard and the finger diagram light up strongly for new keys, softly while a key is being learned, and not at all once it's mastered. Fog rooms hide the keyboard entirely for a bonus.
- **Weak-key targeting:** the game tracks per-key accuracy and latency. Words with weak keys come up more often, and campfires and the dojo offer weak-key drills.
- **Vocabulary:**
  - 613 English words with Korean meanings, from Korean elementary-curriculum themes.
  - Meanings hide once a word is typed perfectly 3 times, and it goes into the Word Book.
  - Finished words are read aloud (en-US).
  - Riddle Stones ask for the English word from its Korean meaning.
- **Korean keyboards:** input uses the physical key position (`KeyboardEvent.code`), so the game works even if the 한/영 key is in Hangul mode. Keycaps show the 두벌식 jamo too.

## Kid-safety and privacy

- No accounts. Names are picked from word lists, never typed.
- No network calls, no analytics, no ads, no purchases.
- Progress is saved in `localStorage` on the device. A **save code** (Settings) moves progress to another computer.
- No leaderboards, streaks, timers, decay or random reward boxes. The town produces coins per completed run, and a small "welcome back" gift never punishes absence.

## Teachers

**Report Card** (title screen) includes:
- a per-key accuracy heatmap
- a chart of recent CPM and accuracy
- mastered and weak keys
- a one-line **teacher summary** to copy, plus printing

## Editing

Source is in `index.html`, `css/` and `js/`. After editing, run `python3 build.py` to regenerate `dist/keyhaven.html`.

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `js/curriculum.js` | Realms, keys, bosses, intro text |
| `js/words.js` | Vocabulary with Korean meanings, plus sentences |
| `js/battle.js` | Combat and the adaptive-speed tuning (`setSpeed`) |
| `js/run.js` | Charms, map generation |
| `js/town.js` | Buildings and the economy |
| `js/pixel.js` | All pixel art (sprites are text grids) |

# 星くずキャッチ (Stardust Catch)

UFOを動かして降ってくる星を集め、隕石をよけるアクションゲームです。Next.js で作り、Vercel にデプロイしています。

## 遊び方

- ⭐ 星をキャッチするとスコア。連続でとるとコンボ倍率（最大 ×5）が上がる
- ☄️ 隕石に当たるとライフが1つ減る。0になったらゲームオーバー
- 💗 ハートでライフ回復（最大5）
- 🛡️ シールド中は隕石をこわしてボーナス
- 時間がたつほどスピードと隕石の数が増える

| 操作 | キー |
| --- | --- |
| 移動 | ← → / A D、マウス、タッチ（ドラッグ） |
| スタート | Space / Enter |
| 一時停止 | P / Esc |
| 消音 | M |

ベストスコアはブラウザに保存されます。

## ローカルで動かす

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

ブラウザで http://localhost:3000 を開きます。

## 構成

- `src/app/page.tsx` — トップページ
- `src/components/GameLoader.tsx` — ゲームをブラウザ側だけで読み込む
- `src/components/StardustGame.tsx` — ゲーム本体（Canvas描画・ゲームループ・効果音）

RaphaelKhalid/clawd-dino.readme:
# Clawd Dino

Chrome's offline dino game, starring Clawd, in Claude Code. While Claude is working, Clawd runs and jumps
over cacti in a strip above your prompt.

## Install

Paste this into Claude Code in your terminal:

```
/plugin install clawd-dino --marketplace RaphaelKhalid/clawd-dino
```

Answer `y` to add the marketplace, then press Enter to install it for your user.

## Play

- Clawd plays on autopilot until you click the strip. Then space or ↑ jumps and ↓ drops faster.
- Hold → or `d` to speed up, ← or `a` to slow down, mid-jump too. Faster scores faster.
- Esc gives the keys back to the prompt. (Pressed while the game isn't focused, Esc interrupts Claude as usual.)
- A game you leave mid-run comes back paused the next time Claude works. Your high score is saved.

It shows in the terminal CLI, including VS Code's integrated terminal, but not in the VS Code extension's
chat panel. It needs a recent Claude Code (`claude update`).

Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Anthropic.

AerithMetiq/CrossCodeBox.desc: Unofficial Android launcher for CrossCode: sign in with Steam, download your own copy, play with Steam Cloud saves.
AerithMetiq/CrossCodeBox.readme:
# CrossCodeBox

Play **CrossCode** on Android. Sign in with Steam, download the copy your account owns, and keep your
save in step with **Steam Cloud**, so you can carry it between your PC and your handheld. Steam
achievements unlock as you play, and community mods are one menu away. Made for controller-first
handhelds and phones; tested on a Retroid Pocket Nova.

> **Unofficial fan project.** Not affiliated with or endorsed by Radical Fish Games or Valve. The app
> contains **no game files and no game art**: you need your own copy of CrossCode on Steam, and the
> game is downloaded from Steam to your device.

## Install

1. Download `CrossCodeBox-1.0.0.apk` from the [latest release](https://github.com/AerithMetiq/CrossCodeBox/releases/latest) and open it on
   the device (allow installs from your browser or file manager when Android asks).
2. Open CrossCodeBox and sign in to Steam: username and password (Steam Guard by app approval or
   code), or **Sign in with QR code** and scan it with the Steam Mobile app.
3. Press **DOWNLOAD**. The game takes about 840 MiB on the device; the download carries on in the
   background with a notification, and can be cancelled. The DLC your account owns (A New Home and the
   skins) comes with it.
4. Press **PLAY**.

Needs Android 8.0 or newer.

## How it works

CrossCode is a web game: HTML5 and JavaScript, shipped on PC inside NW.js. CrossCodeBox downloads only
the game's own files from Steam (its `assets/` folder; the rest of a Steam install is the desktop
runtime) and runs them in Android's WebView, with a small layer standing in for NW.js: it answers the
desktop calls the game makes (files, saves, quitting), serves the files, turns controllers into the
browser's Gamepad API, and adds the Android parts (pausing in the background, the frame-rate limit,
touch controls). Nothing is emulated, and the game's files are never changed.

## What it does

**Steam**
- Signs in with Steam Guard or a QR code that fits any screen, 4:3 included. Your password goes to
  Steam and is never stored; the login token Steam returns is kept encrypted with a key held in the
  Android Keystore.
- Shows your Steam name and avatar, with a green dot while Steam can be reached.
- Checks every downloaded file against Steam's checksums, and offers **UPDATE** when Steam has a newer
  build ("Update now" or "Play this version"). Settings can verify or delete the game files.
- **Achievements** (on by default, Settings → Steam): each one the game awards is unlocked on your
  Steam account, and the ones your save already holds are added the next time it loads. Earned
  offline, they go up once Steam can be reached. Nothing is ever removed.
- **Playing status** (off by default, Settings → Steam): shows you as playing CrossCode on Steam, and
  Steam counts the play time.
- **Steam diagnostics** (Settings): a read-only report of the game's depots, its Steam Cloud rules,
  your Cloud files and your achievements, which you can share. It leaves out your account name.

**Steam Cloud saves**
- PLAY first brings down your save if it is newer in Steam Cloud, then starts the game. Coming back
  from the game syncs again.
- **Uploads are off until you turn them on** (Settings → Steam Cloud saves). Until then your changes
  stay on the device and are counted under PLAY. "Check now" there shows what a sync would do, without
  doing it.
- The save is compared with the last version both sides agreed on, so only the side that changed
  wins. If both changed, you choose which to keep.
- Nothing is lost: a save about to be replaced on the device is copied to a backup first, and before
  an upload replaces the one in Steam Cloud, Steam's copy is kept on the device too. Settings → Steam
  Cloud saves → **Restore a backup** puts any of them back. The app never deletes a file from Steam
  Cloud.
- **Play offline** (under PLAY) skips Steam altogether. If Steam cannot be reached, the game starts
  with the save on the device.
- Under PLAY: when you last played, when the save was last in step with Steam Cloud, and whether it
  has changed since.

**Playing**
- Controllers work as they do on PC. **Back** (or B in the launcher) pauses the game and opens the
  side menu: touch controls on or off, hide them while a controller is in use, dynamic sticks (touch
  anywhere), an FPS / battery / temperature readout, a **frame-rate limit** (30, 45, 60, and 90 or 120
  on screens that have them), Troubleshoot and Exit. Holding a direction scrolls the menu.
- **Touch controls** for phones, with a layout editor and a transparency slider. Made for CrossCode:
  the touch stick always sprints (CrossCode walks below 80 % tilt), dash can be set to fire only on a
  fresh tap of L1/L2, and the controls step aside in cutscenes, conversations and Direct Links so a
  tap reaches the game.
- **Vibration** when the screen shakes, following the game's own Rumble Strength option.
- The game's settings are also in the launcher's Settings → Game, so you can set them before playing.

**Mods** (off by default, Settings → Mods)
- With mods on, CrossCode starts through [CCLoader3](https://github.com/CCDirectLink/CCLoader3), the
  community mod loader, which adds a Mods tab to the game's options.
- **Browse mods** lists the mods in [CCModDB](https://github.com/CCDirectLink/CCModDB), the
  community's mod database. Search, sort by popularity (GitHub stars), name, author or last update,
  either way round, and keep to one category or one author. Installing a mod also installs the mods it
  needs. Each download comes from the mod's own release page and is checked against the database's
  checksum.
- Show only installed mods, or only those with an update, and **Update all** at once.
- **Add a file** installs a `.ccmod` or `.zip` you already have; **Remove a mod** deletes one.
- Verifying the game files leaves your mods alone. Mods are made by other people and run with the
  game: install only ones you trust. They can change your save like the game

Fix garbled small-font text: measure font glyphs without smoothing

drew the next one ("Sipncvt !Trvbsf" for "Rhombus Square" on save slots).

off. Verified on the Nova: all fonts measure 223 glyphs and the Load Game

LiteS1de/egging-on-coop.readme:
Русский · English

Кооператив для Egging On: катите яйца вместе с друзьями —
в одном мире, с телепортом, эмоциями и честной доской позора.

--- ## Что умеет **Вместе в одном мире** - **Друзья рядом.** До 4 игроков: яйца друзей с ником, расстоянием и высотой над ними. Можно толкаться или проходить сквозь друг друга — решает хост. - **Общий мир.** Ящики, вёдра, кастрюли, бутылки и платформы одни на всех. Разбитое окно, колокол, микроволновка и труба — тоже у всех. - **Общие чекпоинты.** Площадка дрона, до которой добрался один, открывается у всех (если в игре включены чекпоинты). **Общение** - **Телепорт к другу** — клавиша T. Мягко падаете на друга, никого не выбивает; при 2+ друзьях — выбор цифрой. - **Эмоции** — зажмите G, наведите мышь на картинку и отпустите: эмоция всплывёт над вашим яйцом. - **Метки** — колёсико мыши: метка туда, куда смотрит камера, с ником и расстоянием. - **Доска позора** — кто больше всех упал, худшее падение, сколько раз разбился. Итоги — на финальных титрах. **Для стримеров** - **Режим стримера** — можно спокойно открывать F9 в эфире: IP-адреса и коды приглашения на экране заменяются точками, и зрители не узнают ни ваш адрес, ни адреса друзей. Кнопка «Копировать» при этом копирует настоящий адрес, так что звать друзей можно не выключая режим. А через Steam адресов не видно вовсе. - **Эффекты от зрителей** за баллы канала и bits Twitch: ветер, прыжок, лунная гравитация, замедление, скользкое яйцо, камера вверх ногами, телепорты и другие. Цена, откат и включение — у каждого свои; награды на канале мод создаёт сам и возвращает баллы, если эффект не смог сработать. **Подключение** - **Через Steam:** хост приглашает друзей из оверлея Steam, друзья жмут «Присоединиться к игре». Связь идёт через серверы Valve: работает за любым роутером, без Radmin и проброса портов, IP-адреса нигде не видны. - Запасные способы — код приглашения, Radmin VPN или IP. Если интернет моргнул, гость переподключается сам. ## В деле

Колесо эмоций и эмоции над яйцами

Эффекты от зрителей: конфетти, лунная гравитация, замедление

Эмоции на ходу

Телепорт к другу — T
## Скриншоты

Эмоции над яйцами — у друга и у вас

Метка с ником и расстоянием

Колесо эмоций — зажать G

F9 → «Доска»: кто сколько упал

F9 → «Игра»: приглашение через Steam, режим стримера прячет адреса

F9 → «Стрим»: эффекты от зрителей Twitch, цены и откаты
## Установка 1. Скачайте `EggCoop-<версия>.zip` из [**Releases**](https://github.com/LiteS1de/egging-on-coop/releases/latest). 2. Распакуйте куда угодно и запустите **`Install.bat`**. 3. ted349624-a11y/flipfight.readme:
# Flipfight

Pixel art NFT kart düellosu. Oyuncular herhangi bir EVM cüzdanıyla (MetaMask, Rabby, Coinbase Wallet, Trust, OKX, Phantom…) giriş yapar, takma ad seçer ve gerçek rakiplerle canlı eşleşir. Tüm tokenlar ve kartlar **demo** varlıklardır ve sunucunun veritabanında tutulur; zincire hiçbir işlem gönderilmez.

## Neler var

- **Cüzdanla giriş (tüm EVM cüzdanları):** Oyuncu ücretsiz bir mesaj imzalar (işlem değil, gas yok). Sunucu imzayı doğrular ve 30 günlük oturum açar.
- **Takma ad:** İlk girişte seçilir, benzersizdir ve değiştirilemez. Lider tablosunda bu görünür.
- **Başlangıç paketi:** Her yeni oyuncuya 200.000 FLIP, 12 başlangıç kartı ve 2 ücretsiz paket.
- **Gerçek zamanlı PvP:** Oda kuyrukları, sunucu tarafında oynanan maçlar, 20 saniyelik tur süresi (süre dolarsa rastgele kart oynanır), sayfa yenilense bile maça geri dönme.
- **Sunucu otoritesi:** Bakiye, kart sahipliği, paket açma (kriptografik rastgelelik), deste kuralları ve maç sonucu tamamen sunucuda hesaplanır. Tarayıcı sadece seçim gönderir.
- **Ekonomi:** Giriş tutarı maç başında kilitlenir, kazanan havuzu alır. %5 komisyonun %40'ı yakılır, %40'ı hazineye, %20'si sezon havuzuna gider. Paket fiyatının yarısı yakılır.
- **Haftalık sezonlar:** Her sezon 7 gün sürer; ELO sezon puanıdır (K=32). Ödül için sezonda en az 3 dereceli maç gerekir. Sezon bitince sunucu otomatik olarak ilk 100'e öder: 1. 1.000.000, 2. 500.000, 3. 250.000, 4-100. sıra `800.000 ÷ sıra` (1.000'e aşağı yuvarlanır; toplam 4.393.000 FLIP). İlk 3 kalıcı rozet alır. Ardından puanlar 1200'e doğru yarı yarıya çekilir ve sezon istatistikleri sıfırlanır. Sunucu uyuyup sezon bitişini kaçırırsa uyanınca telafi eder; her sezon tek bir kilitli işlemde kapanır.
- **Rütbeler:** Bronze, Silver (1150), Gold (1300), Platinum (1450), Diamond (1600), Master (1800) piksel rozetleri; üst barda, maçta ve sıralamada görünür.
- **Lider tablosu ve geçmiş:** Sezon sıralaması, kendi sıran (ilk 100 dışında olsan bile), öngörülen ödül, geri sayım, geçen sezonun şampiyonları, son 20 maç.
- **Günlük bonus:** 24 saatte bir 25.000 FLIP.
- **Market (gerçek zamanlı pazar yeri):** Oyuncular kartlarını FLIP karşılığı listeler; yeni ilanlar, satışlar ve iptaller Socket.io ile herkese anında yansır, satıcıya satış bildirimi gider. Alıcı fiyatı öder, satıcı %5 komisyon düşülmüş tutarı alır (yarısı yakılır, yarısı hazineye). Satın alma tek bir atomik işlemle yapılır; aynı kartı iki kişi aynı anda alamaz. Listelenen kart destede ve Forge'da kullanılamaz; oyuncu en az 5 listelenmemiş kartla kalır, en fazla 20 ilan açabilir.
- **Forge (kart birleştirme):** Aynı nadirlikte 2-4 kart birleştirilir. Başarı şansı `1 − (1 − taban)^(kart − 1)`; tabanlar common→rare %40, rare→epic %25, epic→legendary %12. Başarıda bir üst nadirlikte rastgele kart, başarısızlıkta aynı nadirlikte rastgele bir kart geri gelir; kullanılan kartlar her durumda harcanır ve ücret (5.000 / 20.000 / 60.000 FLIP) yakılır. Oyuncu en az 5 kartla kalır. Oranlar ve beklenen maliyetler: `node scripts/fusion-sim.js`.
- **Bota karşı antrenman:** Ücretsiz, her zaman açık; FLIP, ELO ve maç geçmişini etkilemez. Easy, Normal ve Hard seviyeleri var; bot senin destenin aynısıyla oynar (ayna maç), sonucu sadece hamleler belirler.

## Ada (ana ekran)

Girişten sonra oyuncular ortak bir piksel adada başlar (`public/island.js`, `server/island.js`).
- Her oyuncunun cüzdan adresinden üretilen kendine özel bir karakteri vardır. Dokunulan yere engellerin etrafından dolaşarak yürür (karo haritası üzerinde yol bulma); bilgisayarda ok tuşları ve WASD da çalışır.
- Binalar: Arena, Ranks, Shop, Market, Forge, Cards (koleksiyon), History. Kapısına yürünen ya da dokunulan bina ilgili bölümü açar; dönünce oyuncu o binanın önünde belirir. MENU düğmesi binalara kısayol verir.
- Adadaki herkes gerçek zamanlı görünür (saniyede 10 güncelleme) ve HI!, GG, WOW gibi tepki baloncukları gönderebilir. Ada konumları sadece görseldir; sunucu sınırlandırır ve hız sınırı uygular.

## Atmosfer

`public/fx.js` tamamen tarayıcıda üretilen müzik, sahne ve savaş efektlerini içerir; ses ya da görsel dosyası yoktur.

- **Müzik:** Web Audio ile çalan üç chiptune parça: lobi (sakin), arena (davullu) ve son tur / maç sayısı (hızlı, gergin). Parçalar ölçü başında geçiş yapar. Forge'da ateş çıtırtısı, Market'te ara sıra para sesi var. MUSIC ve SFX düğmeleri ayrı ayrı açılıp kapanır.
- **Sahneler:** Lobi gece gökyüzü (kayan yıldızlar), Rookie ve antrenman alacakaranlıkta çayır (ateş böcekleri), Veteran yanardağ (kor ve kül), Legend gökyüzü tapınağı (bulutlar, uçan adalar, ışıltılar).
- **Savaş:** Kartlar açıldıktan sonra yaratıklar ortada çarpışır; vuruş anında kısa donma, ekran sarsıntısı ve kazananın element efektleri (ateş kıvılcımı, su damlaları, rüzgâr girdabı, toprak parçaları). Kaybeden piksel piksel dağılır. Element avantajında "SUPER EFFECTIVE!", yorgun kartlarda "EXHAUSTED" yazısı çıkar. Tur başında ROUND / MATCH POINT / FINAL ROUND afişleri.
- **Canlılık:** Kartlardaki yaratıklar nefes alır ve göz kırpar. "Hareketi azalt" ayarı açık cihazlarda animasyonlar kapanır.

## Yerelde çalıştırma

Node.js 18 veya üzeri ve bir Postgres veritabanı gerekir (Neon'un ücretsiz veritabanını yerelde de kullanabilirsin).

```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env      # DATABASE_URL satırına bağlantı adresini yaz
npm start
```

Tarayıcıda `http://localhost:3000` adresini aç. Tablolar ilk açılışta otomatik oluşturulur.

Otomatik test (sunucu açıkken, iki sahte cüzdanla tam bir maç oynar):

```bash
node scripts/smoke-test.js http://localhost:3000      # iki oyunculu tam maç
node scripts/practice-test.js http://localhost:3000   # bota karşı antrenman
node scripts/bot-sim.js                               # bot seviyelerinin kazanma oranları (sunucu gerekmez)
node scripts/fusion-sim.js                            # birleştirme oranları ve beklenen maliyetler (sunucu gerekmez)
node scripts/fusion-test.js http://localhost:3000     # birleştirme kuralları ve hata durumları
node scripts/market-test.j

Add the Forge: fuse cards for a chance at the next rarity

Fuse 2-4 cards of one rarity. Each card after the first is an independent
roll at the base rate (common 40%, rare 25%, epic 12%), so
chance = 1 - (1 - base)^(n - 1). Success gives a random card of the next
rarity; failure gives a random card of the same rarity back. Inputs are
always consumed and the fee is burned, making fusion a card and FLIP sink.
Runs in one locked transaction, keeps players at 5+ cards, is blocked
during matches, and logs every fusion for public stats.

Build the player and the stage; give every wallpaper defaults.js

Phase 3. index.html is the player: it picks the wallpaper (?w= for this
load only, else the saved choice, else Seasonal), runs it in a stage
iframe, crossfades between stages, and owns the keys: [ ] to switch,
comma for settings, f for fullscreen. stage.html boots one wallpaper.

Running each wallpaper in its own iframe means a switch drops every
global, listener, timer and canvas, so nothing leaks and no module needs
wrapping. The stage installs itself before any wallpaper code loads: it
paces requestAnimationFrame (fps cap, pause, frame timing) and caps
devicePixelRatio, and the player renders the stage smaller and scales
it up, so the performance tiers apply to every module unchanged. The
two talk only through postMessage, because file:// frames can't reach
into each other.

Every wallpaper now keeps its defaults in defaults.js, with the old
standalone pages' tuning winning, checked against those pages. Settings
are stored as overrides only, through WP.settings. The homepage's status
bar becomes host insets. Snow no longer depends on the homepage at all:
its settings dialog moved in, and two latent bugs in its Apply went with
it. Cherry blossoms no longer leaks a resize listener per start. Advent's
?date= and ?theme= survive as URL parameters.

The new smoke test runs every wallpaper fresh and fails if a fresh run
would save anything, which proves each defaults.js exact. Its player
suite checks Seasonal, ?w=, switching, a leak-free full cycle,
?panel=open, ?tier=low and pause. It caught two real bugs, both fixed:
fireflies sat black for five seconds after every load, and a body
background covered every z-index -1 canvas. Unit tests cover seasons,

GarfieldHuang/ac1-zh-tw-subtitles.desc: 刺客教條 1 Steam 版英中雙語字幕安裝指南與工具（不含遊戲對白）
GarfieldHuang/ac1-zh-tw-subtitles.readme:
# 刺客教條 1（Steam 導演剪輯版）英中雙語字幕安裝指南

讓 Steam 版《刺客教條》一代在對話時顯示「上英文、下繁體中文」的雙語字幕，並整理實測踩過的坑。

> **本 repo 不含任何遊戲對白或翻譯文字。** 字幕內容屬於遊戲版權方，這裡只提供安裝步驟、設定修改、工具腳本與譯名對照表。字幕檔請自行準備（見「字幕檔從哪來」）。

## 成品

![遊戲中的上英下中雙語字幕](docs/images/bilingual-subtitles.jpg)

| 項目 | 狀態 |
|---|---|
| 對話字幕 | 上英下中雙語，時間點與原版同步 |
| 遊戲介面 | 可選繁中（中文介面外掛可能在古代切回現代時崩潰，見下方地雷 4） |
| 開場影片 | 跳過 |

測試環境：Windows 11、Steam 版 v1.02（`AssassinsCreed_Dx9.exe` MD5 `8E72C3333743780E43BC2C34BBF625F9`）。

## 一鍵安裝

下載本 repo（Code → Download ZIP）解壓後，雙擊 **`install.bat`**。它會依序：

1. 從 Steam 資料庫自動找到遊戲資料夾（找不到會請你貼路徑）
2. 備份原本的 `dinput8.dll` 與 `scripts\` 到遊戲資料夾裡的 `_backup_日期時間\`
3. 從 GitHub 下載並安裝三個 mod（版本固定，見下表）
4. 套用設定：字幕框高度修正、跳過開場影片
5. 把微軟正黑體複製成 `scripts\subtitles.ttf`
6. 問你雙語 `subtitles.json` 放在哪（本 repo 不附字幕內容；跳過的話先維持英文字幕）
7. 問你要不要裝中文介面：要的話會開啟其樂帖子讓你下載中文化包，解壓後貼上資料夾路徑，程式會自動挑出 1024 穩定版外掛與原版繁中字庫
8. 把 Steam 啟動選項複製到剪貼簿，你只要到 Steam 貼上

進階用法（全部參數可省略）：

```bat
install.bat -GameDir "D:\Steam\steamapps\common\Assassins Creed" -SubtitlesJson "D:\subtitles.json" -ChinesePackDir "D:\ac1_cn" -Yes
install.bat -SkipChineseUI
```

## 需要的 mod

全部從原作者處下載，本 repo 不轉載：

| Mod | 用途 | 下載 |
|---|---|---|
| Ultimate ASI Loader | 讓遊戲載入 `.asi` 外掛（用 `dinput8.dll`） | [ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases) |
| EaglePatchAC1 | 穩定性修正、跳過開場影片 | [Sergeanur/EaglePatch](https://github.com/Sergeanur/EaglePatch/releases) |
| SubtitleSynchAC1 | 依語音事件顯示同步字幕（讀 `subtitles.json`） | [bloxtbc/SubtitleSynchAC1](https://github.com/bloxtbc/SubtitleSynchAC1/releases) |

## 手動安裝步驟

1. **先備份**遊戲資料夾（Steam：右鍵遊戲 → 管理 → 瀏覽本機檔案）。
2. 把 `dinput8.dll` 放進遊戲根目錄。
3. 在遊戲根目錄建立 `scripts\`，放入：
   - `EaglePatchAC1.asi`、`EaglePatchAC1.ini`
   - `SubtitleSynchAC1.asi`、`SubtitleSynchAC1.ini`、`subtitles.json`、`subtitles.ttf`
4. 套用下面的設定修改。
5. 用雙語 `subtitles.json` 取代原本的英文版，並把 `subtitles.ttf` 換成含中文字的字型。
6. Steam 啟動選項設成直接跑 DX9（見地雷 1）。

### 設定修改

`scripts\SubtitleSynchAC1.ini`（完整檔案見 [`config/SubtitleSynchAC1.ini`](config/SubtitleSynchAC1.ini)）：

```ini
PaddingX=32
PaddingY=16
```

`scripts\EaglePatchAC1.ini`：

```ini
SkipIntroVideos=1
```

字型：把系統的微軟正黑體粗體複製過去改名即可（僅限自己電腦使用，字型授權不允許轉散布）：

```bat
copy C:\Windows\Fonts\msjhbd.ttc "<遊戲資料夾>\scripts\subtitles.ttf"
```

SubtitleSynchAC1 會載入 U+0000–U+FFFF 範圍的字形，所以中日韓字型可以直接用。

## 地雷

1. **只能跑 DX9。** Steam 預設啟動的 `AssassinsCreed_Game.exe` 在 Windows 10/11 會選 DX10，mod 不支援，結果是按下「開始」幾秒就跳回來。Steam → 內容 → 啟動選項填：
   ```
   "<遊戲資料夾>\AssassinsCreed_Dx9.exe" %command%
   ```
2. **雙語第二行被裁掉。** SubtitleSynchAC1 預設 `PaddingY=-25`，字幕框高度 = 文字高度 + PaddingY，單行英文靠 ImGui 最小視窗高度撐住，兩行就會被切掉下面那行。改成正數。
3. **中文顯示成問號或空白。** 附帶的 `subtitles.ttf` 只有拉丁字母，要換成 CJK 字型。
4. **中文介面外掛會崩潰。** 坊間流傳的中文介面包（`LG_AC.asi`，2008 年官方繁中文字）會讓遊戲在 `AssassinsCreed_Dx9.exe+0x54652` 發生存取違規。逐一停用 mod 實測：只有載入它時會崩，其他 mod 單獨都正常。快取 2048 版開機就當，1024 版能玩一陣子，但從古代記憶切回現代時容易當。
   - 除錯器抓到的現場：遊戲背景工作執行緒（`exe+0x57150` 的佇列迴圈）呼叫一個已被釋放的物件；呼叫鏈上沒有 `LG_AC` 自己的程式碼。
   - 已排除：網路連線（加網路封鎖仍當）、CPU 核心數（限 4 核仍 2/3 當）、顯示驅動（換 DXVK 3.1.1 仍 3/4 當）。
   - 實用解法：平常開著中文介面；遇到切回現代就當的段落，關遊戲 → 執行 `tools\toggle-chinese-ui.bat` 關閉 → 讀檔過關 → 再開回來。存檔不受影響。
5. **OneDrive 會被暫停。** Windows 遊戲模式偵測到遊戲時會暫停 OneDrive 同步，遊戲崩潰退出後不會自動恢復。解法：遊戲中按 `Win + G` → 設定 → 取消勾選「記住這是遊戲」，或手動按 OneDrive「繼續同步」。

## 字幕檔從哪來

https://mega.nz/file/qRYXTRDA#fQ49BNxmMSCQbZpbU1-u9A4AatkWXrCyVXlQEvtADfc 中英文字幕

`subtitles.json` 格式是「音效 ID → 字幕文字」，文字中用 `<wait=秒數>` 分段、`<duration=秒數>` 結尾：

```json
{
  "0x20a800e9": "第一段 <wait=1.5> 第二段 <duration=3.0>"
}
```

做法：

1. 從 SubtitleSynchAC1 取得英文 `subtitles.json`。
2. 產生一份 key 相同、只有中文的 `zh.json`。每句的 `<wait>`／`<duration>` 標記必須和英文原句完全一致、順序相同。
3. 用本 repo 的工具合併成雙語：
   ```bash
   python tools/make_bilingual.py subtitles.en.json zh.json subtitles.json
   ```
   工具會逐句比對時間標記，對不上的句子保留英文並列出來。

譯名建議見 [`docs/glossary.md`](docs/glossary.md)。

## 工具

| 檔案 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| [`tools/make_bilingual.py`](tools/make_bilingual.py) | 英文＋中文 JSON 合併成上英下中雙語，並檢查時間標記 |
| [`tools/restore-english.bat`](tools/restore-english.bat) | 移除 `dinput8.dll` 與 `scripts\`，回到原版 |
| [`tools/toggle-chinese-ui.bat`](tools/toggle-chinese-ui.bat) | 若你仍想試中文介面外掛，用來快速開關 `LG_AC.asi` |

兩個 `.bat` 開頭的 `GAME` 變數請改成自己的遊戲路徑。

## 授權

本 repo 的程式與文件採 [MIT](LICENSE)。各 mod 依其原作者授權；遊戲內容版權屬 Ubisoft。

MoonDoes/MoonDoes-CRT-Vision.desc: SymphonyRecomp mod: RetroArch .slangp CRT shaders (MoonDoes / Mega Bezel) on the native PSX picture via librashader OpenGL
MoonDoes/MoonDoes-CRT-Vision.readme:
# MoonDoes CRT-Vision A **SymphonyRecomp** mod that runs RetroArch `.slangp` CRT shader presets — the MoonDoes configuration of the **Mega Bezel** shader chain — directly on the game's **native PlayStation picture**, inside the game process. There is no screen capture, no Vulkan layer, no Zink and no external compositor: the recomp hands its native 256/320/512 × 240 picture to the mod, the mod runs the full preset on it with [librashader](https://github.com/SnowflakePowered/librashader)'s OpenGL runtime on the game's own thread and context, and draws the result 1:1 at whole pixels over the window. > **Status:** Linux x86_64. Tested with SymphonyRecomp v0.5.1b > (RecompOne runtime) on Mesa/radeonsi. ## Screenshots Captured in-game on a 2560 × 1440 monitor with the MoonDoes_Lite_2 preset. Click a picture to open it at full size: the scanlines and the phosphor mask only show at 100 %.

Title screen (512 × 240)
Intro
Prologue — staircase

Prologue — castle hall
Prologue — Dracula
Prologue — the beast

Alucard — entrance hall
Alucard — fire
Alucard — staircase
## Features - **Exact source resolution.** The preset always receives the picture the game really draws on each screen (256 columns in gameplay, 512 on the title and menus, 240 lines), so scanlines and the phosphor mask stay perfectly regular. - **Integer vertical scale.** 6× at 1440p, 4× at 1080p; the mask is rendered at the drawn area's own size, never resampled. - **Gameplay fills the screen.** In gameplay SOTN only draws 207 of its 240 lines. While the game's own black bands stay empty (for half a second), the mod reads just those lines and fills the screen height; title and menus are shown whole in 4:3. Dropping the crop waits 0.75 s, so screen shakes or effects touching the bands do not make the picture jump. - **Fullscreen only.** In windowed mode, or while the mouse is on the menu bar or a menu is open, the recomp's own interface is shown untouched. - **Emissive light (optional).** Bright, coloured pixels (candles, torches, magic) light up their surroundings, on the native picture before the CRT pass, so the glow gets scanlines and mask like everything else. - **Frame generation 60 → 120 (experimental, off by default).** See below. - About **0.2–0.3 ms** of CPU per frame; the game keeps its 60 fps. ## Installation (players) Download the release zip and follow [`docs/INSTALL.md`](docs/INSTALL.md). In short: copy the `crtvision` folder into the game's `mods/` folder, start the game, enable **MoonDoes CRT-Vision** in the **Mods** menu, set the recomp's render scale to **1x** and play in fullscreen. ## Options Mods → MoonDoes CRT-Vision → gear icon. Settings are saved in `mods/crtvision/crtvision.json`. | Option | Default | Notes | |---|---|---| | CRT enabled (fullscreen) | on | | | Mask strength | 0.30 | Phosphor mask (`maskstr`); lower is softer | | Frame generation 60 → 120 (experimental) | off | Linux only, needs VRR; see below | | Emissive light (candles, torches, magic) | on | | | Light intensity | 0.53 | 0 – 2 | | Threshold (what glows) | 0.95 | Brightness from which a pixel emits light | | Radius (reach) | 3.2 px | In native PSX pixels | | Integer vertical scale | on | Whole multiples of the picture's lines | `crtvision.json` also holds `preset` (absolute, or relative to the mod folder), `params` (any preset parameter), and the crop settings (`cropTop`, `cropBottom`, `cropLines`). ### Emissive light A separable gaussian of the picture's bright pixels, added with a screen blend. Coloured light (fire, magic) is favoured over white and grey (text, stone). It is a 2D effect working on the final picture: it cannot tell a light from a very bright, saturated sprite, so some characters may glow slightly. Raise the threshold if that bothers you. ### Frame generation (experimental) Presents 120 pictures per second from the game's 60 without changing the game speed: a picture is generated between each pair of frames by motion estimation on the native picture (8×8 blocks, ±8 px search, integer motion only, so pixel art is never resampled), each one goes through the CRT preset, and the real frame is presented half a frame (8.3 ms) after the generated o

Slurpas/larrutan.readme:
# Lärrutan

A free Swedish literacy adventure game for children aged 5–7. Browser first, made for iPad.

Status: early prototype (Phase 2 started). See `docs/PRD.md` for the product and `docs/CLAUDE_TASKS.md` for the plan.

## Requirements

- Node.js 22.12 or newer (developed on Node 24)

## Setup

```bash
npm install
npx playwright install chromium webkit
```

The second command downloads the browsers used by the browser tests (about 380 MB, once).

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `npm run dev` | Start the dev server (local and on your network) |
| `npm run build` | Type check, then build to `dist/` |
| `npm run preview` | Serve the built `dist/` folder |
| `npm run typecheck` | TypeScript check |
| `npm run lint` | ESLint |
| `npm test` | Unit tests (Vitest) |
| `npm run test:e2e` | Browser tests (Playwright, desktop Chromium + iPad WebKit) |
| `npm run speech` | Generate missing speech clips (see below) |
| `npm run sfx` | Re-synthesise the sound effects in `src/sound/sfx/` (needs ffmpeg) |
| `npm run icons` | Render `scripts/app-icon.svg` to the PNG app icons in `public/icons/` |
| `npm run sprites` | Render every sprite and wardrobe item into `docs/sprites/` for review |

## Generating speech

Everything the game says plays from MP3 files in `src/speech/audio/sv/`, generated from the content with the free, offline Piper text-to-speech engine. The files are committed, so this is only needed after changing letters, words or phrases. A unit test fails if any sentence is missing its file.

One-time setup (Python 3 and ffmpeg on PATH needed; everything installs into `.tools/`, which git ignores):

```bash
python -m venv .tools/piper-venv
.tools/piper-venv/Scripts/python -m pip install piper-tts==1.8.0
.tools/piper-venv/Scripts/python -m piper.download_voices sv_SE-alma-medium --data-dir .tools/piper-voices
```

(On macOS/Linux use `.tools/piper-venv/bin/python`.)

Then:

```bash
npm run speech
```

It generates new clips, regenerates any whose pronunciation or voice settings changed, and deletes unused ones; `npm run speech -- --all` regenerates everything. Words the engine says wrong are fixed in `src/content/pronunciation.ts`. Open the game with `?debug=voices` to see what plays and why.

### Reviewing the voice

Open the game on the dev server with `?review=voices`, for example `http://localhost:5173/?review=voices` (or the Network address on the iPad).

- Every clip is listed per letter and per word. Play each one and mark it **Good** or **Wrong**; for a wrong one, write what's wrong.
- On a PC, the keys are faster: ↓ plays the next clip, A marks it good (and plays the next), R marks it wrong.
- Decisions are saved in `src/speech/audio/sv/approvals.json`. `npm run speech` lists the wrong ones.
- A fixed clip gets a new file name, so it shows up as "to review" again.

## Testing on an iPad

1. Make sure the iPad and this computer are on the same network.
2. Run `npm run dev`.
3. Vite prints two addresses. Open the **Network** one on the iPad in Safari, for example `http://192.168.1.90:5173/`.
   - The port is always 5173. If `npm run dev` says the port is in use, the game is already running in another window: use that one.
4. If the iPad can't connect, Windows Firewall may be blocking Node.js. Allow Node.js on **private** networks when Windows asks, and check that your network is set to Private.

Hold the iPad sideways (landscape). In portrait a small picture hint asks to turn it.

## The hosted game

The game is published at **https://slurpas.github.io/larrutan/** (GitHub Pages; the repository is public).

- Every push to `main` deploys automatically (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`): lint, unit tests and a release build, then publish. That takes a minute or two.
- Watch it on the repository's **Actions** tab.
- The site is hidden from search engines until the release review.

## Saving, offline play and installing

- Progress is saved on the device (IndexedDB) after every round and when something is put on or taken off. Nothing leaves the device.
- To start over, clear the site's data in the browser. On an iPad home-screen app, remove the app and add it again.
- A release build (`npm run build`) works offline after the first visit and can be added to the iPad home screen: in Safari, tap Share, then **Add to Home Screen**. It then opens full screen with its own icon.
- Installing needs HTTPS, so it only works from the hosted site (https://slurpas.github.io/larrutan/), not from the `http://192.168.…` dev address.
- After an update, the new version starts the second time the game is opened.
- The build time in the bottom-right corner of the start screen shows which version is running.

Add Bubblor: Hitta bokstaven as a bubble game (Task 13)

The child's character blows soap bubbles with letters; the voice says
"Hitta alla A!" and the child pops every bubble with that letter. Three
right bubbles per question (15 per round instead of 5). A wrong letter
doesn't pop: its bubbles turn grey and the voice names it. Bubbles bob in
place; nothing is timed or flies away.

ElKev118/ghostrecon2-recomp.readme:
# Ghost Recon 2 — native PC port (static recompilation)

A native Windows build of *Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon 2* (original Xbox, 2004).
The game's own code is statically recompiled from its `default.xbe` into C by
the [xboxrecomp](https://github.com/ElKev118/xboxrecomp/tree/gr2-port) toolkit (a fork of [sp00nznet/xboxrecomp](https://github.com/sp00nznet/xboxrecomp)); the Xbox
hardware and system software are replaced by native code (kernel, NV2A GPU →
Vulkan, MCPX APU → XAudio2, USB pads → SDL2, keyboard and mouse).

**No game data is included.** You need your own copy of the game (Xbox
disc). This repository holds only the port's own source code; the
recompiled game code is generated on your machine from your `default.xbe`.

## Playing (release build)

Requirements: Windows 10/11 x64, a GPU with Vulkan 1.3, and the
[Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64)](https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe).

```
GhostRecon2\
├── ghostrecon2.exe
└── game\              ← the contents of your Ghost Recon 2 disc
    ├── default.xbe
    ├── actor\  character\  media\  ...
```

Copy the whole disc (extracted ISO) into `game\` and run `ghostrecon2.exe`.
The folder can live anywhere and be moved as a whole.

- **Delete** or **Home**: the port's options menu — window mode, VSync,
  frame limit, internal resolution (1x–6x), aspect ratio (4:3 / 16:9
  stretched / fill), anti-aliasing (SMAA), upscaling (FSR 1), sharpening
  (RCAS), downscale filter, shader cache, volume, reverb, rain/ambience
  level, language (restart).
- **F11** or **Alt+Enter**: fullscreen toggle.
- XInput controllers (Xbox 360 / One / Series pads) play as the Xbox pad;
  keyboard and mouse are mapped too (Enter/Esc = START, Space = A, E = B,
  arrows = D-pad, Tab = BACK).

Everything the port writes is in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\GhostRecon2\`:
`SaveData\` (the console's hard disk: saves), `gr2.ini` (options),
`shadercache\`, `logs\`. Nothing is written next to the exe except by the
game itself in `game\`.

## Building from source

1. Clone this repository and the toolkit side by side:
   ```
   XboxRecompProject\
   ├── ghostrecon2\     (this repository)
   └── xboxrecomp\      (branch gr2-port)
   ```
   `git clone -b gr2-port https://github.com/ElKev118/xboxrecomp.git`
2. Put your game's `default.xbe` in `xboxrecomp\game_files\default.xbe` and the
   whole disc in `ghostrecon2\build\Release\game\` (for running).
3. Requirements: Visual Studio 2022 (C/C++), CMake ≥ 3.20, Python 3.10+, Git
   (CMake fetches SDL2, Vulkan headers, volk, glslang, Dear ImGui, SMAA and
   FidelityFX FSR 1).
4. Configure once: `cmake -S . -B build -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64`
5. Generate the recompiled code and build: `bash tools/regen.sh`
   (disassembly → function identification → ABI analysis → C, then the
   build; ~45 min the first time). After that, `cmake --build build --config Release`.

`run_gr2_debug.bat` starts the build with the debugging keys on (F8 log mark,
F7 frame capture, F6 audio capture) and the log in `build\Release\run_debug.log`.

Documentation of the port's internals: `PLAN.md`, `docs/STATUS.md`,
`docs/VULKAN_PLAN.md`, `docs/PORT_MENU_PLAN.md`.

## Legal

Ghost Recon 2 is © Ubisoft / Red Storm Entertainment. This project is not
affiliated with or endorsed by them. It contains no game assets, no Xbox
BIOS or keys, and no recompiled game code; use it only with a copy of the
game you own. Third-party components and their licences are listed in
[THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

Story 10: Protect the endpoints with API key authentication (#21)

Every /games endpoint now requires the owner's key in the X-Api-Key
header and returns a 401 ProblemDetails when it is missing or wrong.
An authentication handler checks the key before model binding, so a
malformed body without a key is also a 401. Keys are compared in
constant time.

Auth is on by default (appsettings.json) and the key is read from
configuration, which is user secrets in local development. Startup
fails with instructions if auth is enabled without a key. Setting
Auth:Enabled to false restores the v1 no-auth behavior; the existing
test factory does this, and the new ApiKeyAuthTests cover the
enabled path. Swagger UI gets an Authorize button for the key.

# EECS 493 Think-Aloud Activities

Static pages used in the EECS 493 (User Interface Development) think-aloud lecture.

- `rooms.html`: Northgate Rooms, a fictional study-room booking site used for an in-class think-aloud.
- `facilitator.html`: Worst Facilitator, a game about think-aloud facilitation.
- `leaderboard.html`: live class leaderboard for the game, meant for the projector.

Served with GitHub Pages: https://farnazj.github.io/eecs493-thinkaloud/

## Connecting the leaderboard (Google Sheets)

1. Create a new Google Sheet.
2. In the sheet, open **Extensions > Apps Script**, replace the contents with `apps_script.gs`, and save.
3. Click **Deploy > New deployment**, choose type **Web app**, set *Execute as* to **Me** and *Who has access* to **Anyone**, then deploy and authorize.
4. Copy the web app URL (it ends in `/exec`) into `BOARD_URL` in `config.js` and push.

Scores land in the sheet's `Scores` tab. The leaderboard only shows the last 3 hours (`BOARD_HOURS` in `config.js`), so each lecture starts fresh. Delete rows in the sheet to remove a score.

dkaminsky100-coder/last-card.readme:
# Last Card

A single-player shedding card game in the browser: you against 1–3 computer
opponents. Plain HTML, CSS and ES modules. No build step, no dependencies.

**▶ Play it now: https://dkaminsky100-coder.github.io/last-card/**

## Play and install

**Online (easiest):** open the hosted game at
https://dkaminsky100-coder.github.io/last-card/ and play right away. To install
it as an app, use the install icon in Chrome or Edge's address bar, or
Share → Add to Home Screen on iOS. Once installed, it has its own window and
Start-menu/home-screen icon and works offline.

**From a clone:** double-click **`play.bat`** (Windows), or run **`./play.sh`**
(macOS/Linux). Either one starts a local server on port 8000 and opens your
browser. You can install the app from there too. They need Python 3 or
Node.js. Set `PORT` to use another port.

**Manually:** ES modules need a real HTTP server (opening `index.html` from
disk won't work):

```sh
npx serve .                  # then open the URL it prints
# or
python -m http.server 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```

### Publishing your copy

`.github/workflows/pages.yml` runs the tests and deploys the game to GitHub
Pages on every push to `main` or `master`. For a fork, enable it once under
**Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Source: GitHub Actions**.

## Development

Tests and the bot simulation need Node 18 or newer:

```sh
node --test        # engine + bot tests (includes 1,000 seeded random games)
node sim.js        # bots play each other: 500 games per matchup, prints win rates
node sim.js 2000   # more games for tighter numbers
```

## How to play

On your turn, play a card that matches the discard pile's **color** or
**number/symbol**, or play a Wild. If you can't play, draw one card. If the
drawn card fits, you may play it right away or keep it and pass. Be the first
to empty your hand.

| Control | Mouse / touch | Keyboard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Play a card | Tap a lifted card | <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> to choose, <kbd>Enter</kbd> to play |
| Draw | Tap the draw pile | <kbd>D</kbd> |
| Call "Last card!" | Tap the button | <kbd>L</kbd> |
| Keep a drawn card and pass | Tap the button | <kbd>P</kbd> |
| Sound on/off | Speaker button | <kbd>M</kbd> |

Each color also has a shape (red ▲, yellow ●, green ■, blue ◆), shown in the
card corners, the color picker and the current-color indicator.

## Features

- **1–3 bots, each with its own difficulty.** Set them on the start screen, e.g.
  one easy and one hard.
- **Light and dark themes.** Choose Auto (follows your OS), Light or Dark on
  the start screen.
- **Sound effects,** synthesized with Web Audio, so there are no audio files.
  Toggle with the speaker button or <kbd>M</kbd>.
- **Stats across games:** win rate, rounds won, best round, total points and
  win streaks. Open **Your stats** from the menu. Your record also shows on
  the game-over screen.
- **Installable and offline.** A service worker caches the game, so once
  loaded it works without a connection. In Chrome or Edge, use the install
  icon in the address bar. On iOS Safari, use Share → Add to Home Screen.
  Installing needs `https://` or `localhost`.
- **Resume:** the game in progress is saved, so a reload picks up where you
  left off.

## Rules

**Deck (108 cards).** Each of red, yellow, green and blue has one 0, two each
of 1–9, and two each of Skip, Reverse and Draw Two. Plus 4 Wild and 4 Wild
Draw Four.

**Deal.** 7 cards each, then the top card of the deck starts the discard pile.
- A Wild Draw Four can't start the pile. It goes back in and the deck is reshuffled.
- A Wild lets the first player pick the color.
- A Skip, Reverse or Draw Two acts as if the dealer had just played it.

**Playing.** A card is playable if its color matches the current color or its
value matches the top card. Wilds are always playable. A Wild Draw Four is
legal only if you hold no card of the current color.

**Action cards.**
- **Skip:** the next player loses their turn.
- **Reverse:** flips the direction of play. With 2 players it acts as a Skip.
- **Draw Two:** the next player draws 2 and loses their turn.
- **Wild:** choose the new color.
- **Wild Draw Four:** choose the color. The next player draws 4 and loses their turn.

**Drawing.** If you have no playable card you draw one. If it's playable you
may play it; otherwise your turn passes. When the draw pile runs out, the
discard pile (except its top card) is shuffled into a new draw pile.

**"Last card!"** When you're down to one card you must call it before the next
player acts: press the button while holding 2 cards (before you play) or
right after you play down to 1. Miss it and you draw 2 as a penalty. Bots call
too, though easy bots sometimes forget.

**Scoring.** The round ends when someone plays their last card. If that card
is a Draw Two or Wild Draw Four, the next player still draws. The winner
scores the cards left in everyone else's hands: number cards at face value,
Skip/Reverse/Draw Two 20, Wild and Wild Draw Four 50. First to **200** wins
the game.

**House rules** (off by default, set on the start screen):
- **Stack Draw Two:** answer a Draw Two with another Draw Two to pass the
  penalty along. The total grows until someone can't stack and draws the lot.
- **Challenge Wild Draw Four:** a Wild Draw Four may be played as a bluff even
  while holding the current color. The victim can challenge. If the player was
  bluffing, they draw 4 instead and the victim plays normally. If not, the
  challenger draws 6 and loses their turn.

## Bots

- **Easy:** plays a random legal card and forgets to call "Last card" 25% of
  the time.
- **Medium:** prefers number cards, saves Wilds for when nothing else works,
  dumps action cards when an opponent is close to going out, and picks the
  Wild color it holds most of.
- **Hard:** everything medium

  the GPU re-ran each frame (Browse: 55 layers, 2.8 s of a 6.1 s scroll

  off the main thread from a Blob (coverBackdrop.ts) and cached per URL.
  A canvas per card was tried and rejected: each became its own layer.
