# MatchDay Alerts [![CI](../../actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](../../actions/workflows/ci.yml) Follow your teams across the NFL, NBA, NHL and MLB, see their games live on one page, and get a Telegram message at kickoff and at the final score. No sign-up. Final project for [AI Dev Tools Zoomcamp 2026](https://github.com/DataTalksClub/ai-dev-tools-zoomcamp/tree/main/project). It grows the module 02 *ScoreFeed* homework into a production service, reusing the module 03 deployment and module 04 observability / incident-response patterns. | Environment | URL | Upstreams | |---|---|---| | Production | `https://matchday..sslip.io` *(filled in after first deploy)* | real ESPN, real Telegram bot | | Dev | `https://dev..sslip.io` | fake-espn (ESPN + Telegram stand-in), used for the incident demo | | Grafana | `https://grafana..sslip.io` | login required | | Local | http://localhost:8080 · Grafana http://localhost:3000 | fake-espn |

--- ## Contents 1. [Problem](#1-problem) 2. [Features and expected behavior](#2-features-and-expected-behavior) 3. [Quick start](#3-quick-start) 4. [Architecture](#4-architecture) 5. [Tech stack](#5-tech-stack) 6. [Repository structure](#6-repository-structure) 7. [API reference](#7-api-reference) 8. [Data model](#8-data-model) 9. [Configuration](#9-configuration) 10. [Testing](#10-testing) 11. [Containers](#11-containers) 12. [Deployment and CI/CD](#12-deployment-and-cicd) 13. [Observability](#13-observability) 14. [Alerting](#14-alerting) 15. [On-call agent](#15-on-call-agent) 16. [Agent team, spec and context](#16-agent-team-spec-and-context) 17. [Reviewer checklist (all 12 criteria)](#17-reviewer-checklist-all-12-criteria) 18. [Project status](#18-project-status) 19. [Makefile commands](#19-makefile-commands) 20. [Troubleshooting](#20-troubleshooting) 21. [Documentation index](#21-documentation-index) --- ## 1. Problem Fans who follow a few teams across leagues must open a sports app and dig through every league's scoreboard to learn whether their team plays today, whether the game has started, and how it ended. Generic apps need an account, push far too much, and bury the one score that matters. **Users** - **Fan** — follows 1–10 teams, checks scores on a phone, wants a ping at kickoff and at the final whistle, nothing else. - **Operator** — runs the service on one EC2 host, needs to know when fans stop getting scores or notifications, and wants an agent to fix routine breakage (ESPN schema changes). **Out of scope:** password accounts, play-by-play, odds, channels other than Telegram, leagues beyond the four above, LLM-generated content. ## 2. Features and expected behavior Full stories with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria: [`docs/product/spec.md`](docs/product/spec.md). | Story | Feature | Expected behavior | |---|---|---| | S1 | Anonymous identity | First request creates a user and sets an HttpOnly `md_uid` cookie; no sign-up | | S2 | Browse and follow teams | Team list per league with search; follow/unfollow with a star; idempotent; followed teams listed first | | S3 | **My Games** (key journey) | Today's games of followed teams, any league, live score/period/clock, refreshed every 15 s, paused in background tabs. ESPN down → last known scores + "out of date" banner; nothing cached → error message | | S4 | Connect Telegram | *Connect Telegram* opens `t.me/?start=` (15 min, single use); bot replies "Connected"; `/stop` or *Disconnect* unlinks | | S5 | Game notifications | Worker polls ESPN for followed leagues; `pre→in` sends "🟢 Kickoff: DAL @ STL (NHL)", `in→post` (or `pre→post`) sends "🏁 Final: DAL 2 – 3 STL (NHL)"; at most once per fan/game/kind; 3 delivery attempts with backoff; no back-fill after downtime | | S6 | Notification history | Last 50 notifications with Delivered / Sending… / Failed | | S7 | Operability | `/api/health`, `/api/ready`, `/api/version`; telemetry; alerts; on-call agent | | S8 | Daily digest | *Stretch — not implemented* | ## 3. Quick start **Requirements:** Docker with Compose v2. For running tests outside Docker: [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and Node 22. ```sh git clone && cd matchday make up # = docker compose up --build -d --wait ``` This starts 11 containers: postgres, fake-espn, api, worker, frontend, otel-collector, prometheus, loki, tempo, grafana, alert-bridge. | URL | What | |---|---| | http://localhost:8080 | MatchDay app | | http://localhost:3000 | Grafana, home dashboard **MatchDay** (anonymous admin locally) | | http://localhost:9090 | Prometheus | | http://localhost:8090/_control | fake-espn state (game overrides, drift mode) | | http://localhost:8095/incidents | alert-bridge incidents | **Try the whole journey locally (≈ 2 minutes)** 1. Open http://localhost:8080 → **Teams** → **NHL** → star **St. Louis Blues** → **My Games**: the DAL @ STL game appears (scheduled). 2. `make demo-live` → within ~15 s the card shows **LIVE 1–0**, no reload. 3. Connect Telegram locally (the fake bot): press **Connect Telegram**, copy the `start=` token from the opened URL, then `curl -XPOST localhost:8090/_control/telegram/updates -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"chat_id":1,"text":"/start "}'` (the e2e test does exactly this). 4. `make demo-final` → **FINAL 3–2**; `curl localhost:8090/_control/telegram/messages` shows the kickoff and final messages, each once; the **Notifications** tab shows them as Delivered. 5. `make demo-drift` → ESPN "changes" its schema → about a minute later the Grafana alert **ESPN scoreboard schema drift** fires → `curl localhost:8095/incidents` shows an incident with collected context. `make demo-reset` restores. Use the real ESPN API locally: `ESPN_BASE_URL=https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports make up`. Stop everythin

EdgarSawtelle/bright-qud.desc: Bright, bold visual overhaul + quality-of-life mod for Caves of Qud (Steam Deck friendly)
EdgarSawtelle/bright-qud.readme:
# Bright Qud

A bright, bold visual overhaul and quality-of-life mod for **Caves of Qud** (game build 2.0.211),
made on and for the **Steam Deck**, and it works on PC too.

Bold outlines, saturated colours and readability first. **Gameplay is unchanged**: Bright Qud edits
no creatures, items or stats and stores nothing in your save, so you can turn it off at any time.
Every helper below has its own switch in **Options → Mods**.

![Joppa with Bright Qud](screenshots/joppa.png)

## What it does

### A new look
- **Everything is replaced**: every creature, character, item, piece of furniture and terrain tile
  the game uses has a Bright Qud version (about 3,900 tiles, ~1,700 different sprites), world map
  included.
- **New tiles** for the world: ground, walls in 3/4 view, water, plants, furniture and items.
- **Characters and monsters** redrawn in a "weird retro sci-fi" style. Snapjaws are hyena-folk,
  villagers have recognisable silhouettes, robots are chrome with glowing lights, and the hostile
  plants have maws.
- **Mutations show on characters**: horns, wings, extra arms, carapace, quills, stinger, two heads
  and more appear on human-shaped characters, including you.
- **Your colours are kept**: creatures and villages generated by the world seed keep their own
  colours, painted onto the new art.
- **Other mods' tiles get restyled**: tiles Bright Qud doesn't know (from content mods) get brighter
  colours and outlines, so the whole world matches.
- **Player look**: pick a sprite for your character (Gunslinger, Mystic, Tinker, Warden...).
- **Idle animation**: creatures bob gently and wings flap.

### Easier to read the map
| Helper | What you see |
|---|---|
| Threat rings | red ring under enemies, green under companions |
| Health bars | small bar over hurt creatures |
| Your ring | warm ring under you; it turns red and pulses when your health is low |
| Item sparkle | items lying on the ground twinkle |
| Talk bubbles | speech bubble over merchants and named characters; it fades once you've talked |
| Gold corners | stairs and containers that still hold items |
| Clear memory | remembered areas (out of sight) are clearly dimmer than what you see now |
| Coloured ground | real ground colours instead of black |
| Fire and effects | flames drawn on burning things; no black squares behind gas, explosions or thrown items |
| World map danger | regions too dangerous for your level are tinted orange (hard) or red (deadly); look at a region to see its level. World-map colours are toned down. |

### Easier to read the menus
- **Clearer font**: *Clear mono* (detailed and aligned) or *Readable* (Atkinson Hyperlegible, made
  for low vision), or keep the game's own font.
- **Interface colours** *(experimental)*: Qud teal (default), Tan parchment (light), Amber, Rust,
  Violet, Slate.
- **Key stats at a glance**: looking at or hovering over things puts a short summary on top of the
  description.
  - Monsters: level, HP, AV/DV, attacks with damage, ranged weapon, mutations.
  - Each mutation and fight skill gets a one-line explanation, red if it's dangerous to you
    (e.g. `Freezing Ray - ranged cold beam, can freeze you solid`), plus a status line
    (on fire, stunned...).
  - Items: damage, penetration, armour, resistances, charge, liquid contents, weight.
  - Unidentified items stay unspoiled.
- **Quest helper**: LT + left stick click (or F4) lists your quests, nearest first, with the next
  step and roughly where it is ("3 regions NE"). Pick one to follow: a small banner under the status
  bar keeps showing what to do next. Nothing is stored in your save.
- **Item comparison**: weapons, armour and shields show the difference with what you wear in that
  slot, in green (better) or red (worse), e.g. `[AV +1 DV -1]` or `[dmg +1.5]`. It works in the
  inventory, when picking things up, and at merchants. The description adds a
  "Compared with your …" line.
- **Ability bar**: more abilities fit at once (*More* / *Most*), so there's less paging. Pointing at an
  ability, or selecting it with the controller, shows what it does, its cooldown and whether it's on.
- **Controls reminder** (LT + View, or F3): the most useful commands for a playthrough on a gamepad.
  Pick one to use it.
- **Legend**: what every marker and colour means (Options → Mods → "show legend").

## Screenshots
| | |
|---|---|
| ![Key stats when you look at a creature](screenshots/look-stats.png) | ![Item comparison](screenshots/item-compare.png) |
| Key stats on top of the description | Item comparison with what you wear |
| ![Controls reminder](screenshots/controls-reminder.png) | ![Amber interface colours](screenshots/amber-theme.png) |
| Controls reminder (LT + View) | Amber interface colours and the Clear mono font |

## Install
- **Steam Workshop**: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3825185564 (subscribe, then enable it in the Mods menu).
- **Manually**: copy the `mod/BrightQud` folder into your Caves of Qud mods folder, then enable
  "Bright Qud" in the game's Mods menu and restart.
  - Linux / Steam Deck: `~/.config/unity3d/Freehold Games/CavesOfQud/Mods/`
  - Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Freehold Games\CavesOfQud\Mods\`

## Compatibility
Bright Qud uses only visual and UI Harmony patches, and every patch fails safely. Content mods work:
their creatures and items get the automatic restyle. Other tile packs that replace the same tile
files: whichever loads last wins for each tile. Details: [docs/COMPATIBILITY.md](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md).

## For modders / contributors
- The art is written as text grids in `art/src/*.py` (16×24 tiles with recolourable roles) and
  built by `tools/build_mod.py`.
- The runtime is C# with Harmony in `mod/BrightQud/*.cs`. How it works:
  [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).
- Building the tiles needs your own extracted game tiles in `reference/`. They are never part of
  this repository.

## Licence
- Art: [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org

Coral-coder/openmtg.readme:
# OpenMTG

A free, fan-made Magic: The Gathering game: every card from Scryfall, a rules engine built on
the Comprehensive Rules, and a visual theme for each set or universe. One Flutter codebase for
the browser (GitHub Pages), Android and iOS. It grew out of
[MagicTrek](https://github.com/coral-coder/magictrek).

- Play in the browser: <https://coral-coder.github.io/openmtg/play/> (once Pages is on)
- The plan, architecture and milestones: [docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md)

## Layout

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/rules/` | The rules engine, pure Dart and deterministic. `lib/src/game/` is organised by CR area, `lib/src/oracle/` turns oracle text into the ability IR, `lib/src/ai/` is the computer player. |
| `packages/rules/bin/build_db.dart` | Scryfall bulk data → `cards.json`, `printings.json`, `coverage.json`, `manifest.json`. |
| `packages/rules/bin/chaos.dart` | Plays hundreds of bot games and replays each from its log, comparing fingerprints. |
| `packages/rules/bin/cards.dart` | Coverage of one set, or one card's parse: `dart run bin/cards.dart test/fixtures/fdn.json "Llanowar Elves"`. |
| `lib/` | The app: `app/` (store, sessions, card data, sounds, updater), `net/` (lockstep protocol, Nostr relays, Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth), `theme/`, `ui/`. |
| `assets/data/pool.json` | The bundled, playable card pool (Foundations). The full database is downloaded on demand from the site. |
| `site/` | The landing page; the web build goes under `/play/`, the card data under `/data/`. |
| `tools/fetch_scryfall.sh` | Downloads Scryfall's bulk files politely. |

## Working on it

    flutter pub get
    (cd packages/rules && dart test && dart run bin/chaos.dart --games 200)
    flutter test                      # widget tests; phone-size screenshots land in build/screenshots/
    flutter run -d chrome

    # The card database from Scryfall (about 105 MB of downloads):
    tools/fetch_scryfall.sh .scryfall-cache
    (cd packages/rules && dart run bin/build_db.dart --oracle ../../.scryfall-cache/oracle-cards.jsonl.gz \
        --default ../../.scryfall-cache/default-cards.jsonl.gz --out ../../build/data)

App id: `com.lightwave.openmtg.app` (Android and iOS). Version 1.0.0.

## Releases

The word **build** in a commit subject (or `*u`) releases both platforms from that commit;
`*b` archives iOS without uploading. A `v*` tag also releases.

- `.github/workflows/android-release.yml`: signed APK as a GitHub Release with `OpenMTG.apk` and
  `update.json`; installed copies update themselves from it.
- `.github/workflows/ios-testflight.yml`: archives with cloud signing and uploads to TestFlight.
- `.github/workflows/pages.yml`: the website, the browser game and the card data, on pushes to
  main and weekly.
- `.github/workflows/flutter-ci.yml`: engine tests, chaos harness, coverage floor, analyzer,
  widget tests and a web build on every branch and pull request.

## Setting up the repository

**GitHub Pages**: Settings → Pages → Source: *GitHub Actions*. The `github-pages` environment
deploys from `main`.

**iOS / TestFlight**: run *Actions → Set up app repo* in `Coral-coder/Dev_deploy_setup` with
`repos = openmtg` (its `SECRETS_TOKEN` must include this repository). That copies
`APPLE_TEAM_ID`, `ASC_KEY_ID`, `ASC_ISSUER_ID`, `ASC_KEY_P8` (required) and the optional ones.
Then register the app: either add `APPLE_ID` and `FASTLANE_SESSION` (from
`fastlane spaceauth -u you@example.com`) so the workflow creates the App Store Connect record,
or create it once by hand (Apps → + → New App, bundle ID `com.lightwave.openmtg.app`, name
OpenMTG). Optional repository variables: `BUNDLE_ID`, `APP_NAME`, `APP_SKU`.

**Android signing** (so every release can update the last one in place), either:
- add a `SECRETS_TOKEN` secret (a classic token with `repo`, or fine-grained with *Secrets: read
  and write* on this repo): the first release creates a keystore and stores
  `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64`, `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, `ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS`,
  `ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD`, attaching an encrypted backup to the run; or
- set those four secrets yourself from a key made with
  `keytool -genkeypair -keystore openmtg.jks -storetype PKCS12 -alias openmtg -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 36500`.

Workflows need read and write permissions (Settings → Actions → General → Workflow
permissions) for publishing releases.

## Legal

OpenMTG is unofficial Fan Content permitted under the Fan Content Policy. Not approved/endorsed
by Wizards. Portions of the materials used are property of Wizards of the Coast. ©Wizards of the
Coast LLC. Card data and images courtesy of [Scryfall](https://scryfall.com); images are shown
whole, never cropped. Free, no ads, nothing to buy. The themes are fan tributes inspired by their
settings, drawn from scratch, and not affiliated with their owners.

Statics and casting mechanics: restrictions, shocklands, convoke, delve, storm, cascade and more

- Restrictions: "doesn't untap" on Auras, can block only fliers, can't attack alone, can't be
  blocked by more than one creature, can't attack unless the defender controls an Island,
  "has first strike as long as it's attacking", control-changing Auras.
- Lands: shocklands (pay 2 life or enter tapped), "enters tapped unless ..." conditions,
  "enters tapped with charge counters". Playing a land is now a task, so it can ask.
- Activation limits: "during your turn, before attackers are declared", "during your upkeep",
  "only if you have no cards in hand". Mana abilities with timing limits stay unsupported.
- Casting: convoke, improvise and delve (no pick: only as many as needed, chosen the same way
  on every device), buyback, rebound, storm, cascade (spells cast while resolving).
- Combat and upkeep: flanking; echo, fading, vanishing and cumulative upkeep (mana costs).
- Chaos harness: --only N traces one game; boards over 250 permanents stop as unfinished
  (Troubling Tribbles doubles every turn).
- Tests: test/statics_test.dart on test/fixtures/statics.json. Coverage 11,779 -> 12,417.

# Puzzlegrad

Вертикальная Android-игра: игроки по очереди тянут карты из общей стопки и строят города, дороги, реки и крепости. Очки дают достроенные объекты, побеждает тот, у кого больше очков, когда стопка закончится.

- `web/game.html` — вся игра (HTML/JS, поле в 3D через CSS). Открывается и как макет в браузере.
- `app/` — Android-оболочка (WebView) с автообновлением.
- `scripts/wrap-web.sh` — копирует игру в `app/src/main/assets/index.html`.

Карта проекта — [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), планы — [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md).

## Как выходят обновления

1. Меняете игру, пишете список изменений в `release-notes.md`.
2. Пушите в `main`. GitHub Actions собирает APK и публикует релиз `v<номер>`.
3. При запуске приложение спрашивает у GitHub последний релиз. Если номер больше установленного, показывает «Что нового» и по кнопке «Обновить» скачивает и ставит APK.

Все сборки подписаны одним ключом `app/release.keystore`, иначе Android не даст поставить обновление поверх. Пароль можно переопределить секретами `KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`/`KEY_PASSWORD`.

## Локальная сборка

```sh
./scripts/wrap-web.sh
./gradlew assembleRelease
```

## Google Play

Сборка `play` (AAB) — для магазина, обновляется через Google Play. Сборка `github` (APK) обновляет себя из GitHub Releases. Инструкция и тексты для магазина: [docs/google-play.md](docs/google-play.md).

Один свайп — «назад», два на главном экране — выход

One swipe is "back"; two on the main menu exit

The app hid both system bars, so on gesture navigation the first edge
swipe only brought the bars back ("swipe again"). Now only the status
bar is hidden; the gesture bar stays, transparent and drawn over the
page (its height is added to the bottom inset), so one swipe reaches
onBackPressed. In the page, "back" closes a dialog, goes back a screen,
cancels a search or opens the game menu; on the main menu the first
one warns and a second within 2 s closes the app.

Profile accounts with cloud save, paid rename, architecture and roadmap

- First start offers "Начать" (tutorial, then a nickname: registering
  the profile) or "У меня есть профиль — войти". After registration the
  profile can be protected with an e-mail and password: the anonymous
  Firebase account is upgraded in place (same uid), and the wallet is
  saved to /profiles/{uid} on every change. Signing in on a fresh
  install loads it back; a linked account is never silently replaced by
  a new anonymous one. Password reset by e-mail.
- Settings show the profile: rename for 500 gold, protect / sign in.
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (map of the code and data) and docs/ROADMAP.md;
  the README links them. Stop tracking scripts/__pycache__.

Profiles, a prettier rating, inactivity handling, size-aware matchmaking

- Profile: a nickname (and colour) is chosen after the tutorial or on
  skipping it; it is seat 1 on this phone, the online name, the rating
  name and the presence name, and is changed in Settings only.
- Rating tab: a podium for the top 3, places 4-10 with avatars, and
  your own place below when you are not in the top 10.
- When the turn clock runs out the card goes to a random fitting spot
  and there are 10 seconds to place a figure; doing nothing then counts
  as a skipped turn and takes the player out of the game ("Из-за
  бездействия…"): a bot plays for them, figures included, until they tap
  "Вернуться в партию" (a bot move in progress then is not counted).
  An online game is remembered for 3 hours and offered from the menu
  after a restart.
- Quick match pairs by mode and table size; a room of the same mode
  for another size is offered with a "join" button.

  the spot or button to tap pulses, other spots are hidden, and nothing

  Quick match is rated: fixed rules per mode, players are matched by
  mode as well, and only rated games give cups.

alexandruradu2002-pixel/bible-game-desen.readme:
# Bible Game: desenele

Desenele jocului [Bible Game](https://biblegame.gymmy.ro) (pixel art de 32 de pixeli), puse aici ca să poată fi
folosite și de alții, așa cum cer licențele lor. Codul jocului nu e aici.

Aproape toate pornesc din pachetele gratuite **Liberated Pixel Cup (LPC)** de pe OpenGameArt.org și din generatorul de
personaje LPC. Pentru fiecare fișier, `credite/` spune din ce e făcut, cine l-a desenat, sub ce licență e și ce am
schimbat noi (`credite/CREDITE.md` pentru `grafica/`, iar `credite/<capitol>-CREDITE.md` pentru `grafica/<capitol>/`).

**Licențele:**

- Un desen făcut din materiale LPC rămâne sub licențele materialelor din care pornește (scrise în `credite/`: de cele
  mai multe ori CC-BY-SA 3.0/4.0, GPL 3.0, OGA-BY 3.0 sau CC0). Ce am schimbat noi peste ele se dă sub aceleași licențe.
- Desenele făcute de noi de la zero (scrise în `credite/` ca „desenat de noi”) sunt sub **CC-BY-SA 4.0**.
- Cine le folosește trebuie să-i treacă pe autori (lista din `credite/`) și, la licențele share-alike, să-și dea mai
  departe desenele făcute din ele cu aceleași condiții.

---

**English:** the pixel art of the game Bible Game, mostly derived from the free Liberated Pixel Cup (LPC) packs on
OpenGameArt.org. `credite/` lists, for every file, its sources, authors, licenses and our changes. Derived drawings
keep the licenses of their sources (mostly CC-BY-SA 3.0/4.0, GPL 3.0, OGA-BY 3.0, CC0); our changes are released
under the same licenses, and drawings made from scratch by us are CC-BY-SA 4.0. Please credit the authors listed there.

# 小朋友下樓梯 NS-SHAFT Online

1997 年經典小遊戲《小朋友下樓梯》的網頁復刻版，加上全服排行榜、幽靈殘影對戰和 LINE 分享。

## 玩法

- **← / →** 或 **A / D**（手機按畫面下方按鈕）左右移動，一直往下走，別被天花板的尖刺夾到，也別掉出畫面
- 地板種類：一般、尖刺（扣血）、彈簧床、左右輸送帶、假地板（踩了會翻掉）
- **📅 同圖競技**：所有人玩同一張地圖，可以和排行榜上其他人的 👻 殘影一起跑
- **🎲 隨機地圖**：經典模式，每局隨機，不會留下殘影
- 死掉後可以上傳成績、產生戰績圖、用 LINE 傳給朋友挑戰

## 執行方式

純靜態網頁，有兩種跑法：

**1. 直接開（GitHub Pages 或任何靜態主機）**：排行榜存在 Firebase Realtime Database。

**2. 本機伺服器**：需要 Node.js，不用裝任何套件。

```bash
node server.js          # http://localhost:3081，可用 PORT 環境變數改 port
```

如果要用 `server.js` 自己存排行榜（存在 `shaft_leaderboard.json`），把 `game.js` 裡的 `FIREBASE_DB_URL` 改成空字串 `''`。

## Firebase 設定

1. 在 Firebase Console 建一個 Realtime Database
2. 把資料庫網址填進 `game.js` 的 `FIREBASE_DB_URL`
3. 到 Realtime Database →「規則」，貼上 `database.rules.json` 的內容並發布。這份規則讓玩家只能新增成績，不能修改或刪除別人的紀錄

資料結構：`/records/<id>` 存成績，`/ghosts/<id>` 另外存殘影軌跡，讓排行榜下載量保持很小。

殘影每 0.1 秒記一格，上限 30 分鐘（18000 格，約 216 KB）；只有能進前 50 名的成績才會上傳殘影。規則會拒絕超過 18000 格的殘影。

## 更新後記得

改了 `game.js` 或 `style.css` 之後，把 `index.html` 裡的 `?v=2` 往上加一，玩家的手機才會抓到新版，不會繼續用快取的舊檔。

## 管理員

入口是隱藏的，畫面上不會有任何提示。

### 登入

1. 長按左下角的版本號（例如 `v2026.10.22h`）**3 秒**，會跳出管理員面板。
2. 按「Google 登入」，用管理員的 Google 帳號登入。
3. 登入後排行榜每一列旁邊會出現 🗑️。

### 刪除紀錄

- 按排行榜某一列的 🗑️，確認後會同時刪掉那筆紀錄和它的殘影。
- 刪除**無法復原**，按之前先確認名次、名字、層數。
- 只能一筆一筆刪，不能修改紀錄內容。

### 清理孤兒殘影

- 「孤兒殘影」是紀錄已經不在、但殘影還留著的資料（例如在 Firebase 主控台手動刪紀錄時沒刪到殘影）。
- 在管理員面板按「清理孤兒殘影」，會一次清掉所有孤兒殘影，並顯示清掉幾筆。

### 登出

在管理員面板按「登出」。

### 權限說明

- 真正的權限由 `database.rules.json` 裡的管理員 UID 控制。別人就算找到入口、用自己的 Google 帳號登入，刪除也會被 Firebase 擋下。
- 要換管理員：在 Firebase 主控台 → Authentication 找到新帳號的 UID，改掉規則裡的 UID 後重新發布規則。
- 規則改過之後，記得到 Firebase 主控台 → Realtime Database → 規則，貼上新的 `database.rules.json` 並發布。

Xuanhuy39/tidy.readme:
# Tidy Up!

A cozy 3D sorting puzzle for the browser, built with three.js, TypeScript and Vite.

Tap the clutter in a room to tidy it. Each item flies into the open box for its category (Snacks, Stationery, Electronics …). If no open box takes it, it waits in the tray. When a box fills it closes and the next category's box opens in its place, pulling any matching items out of the tray. Items with something resting on top can't be picked until that's cleared. The tray holds 5 items; filling the last slot loses the level (a booster can rescue you).

Boosters: **Return** puts the last 3 tray items back in the room (2 per level), the locked **+** tray slots add space, **Extra box** opens a third box early, and **Hint** points at a good move (3 per level, free). Finish without Return/slots/box for 3 stars.

The game always plays in a portrait phone-shaped frame (9:16); on a PC it sits centred in the window.

Levels: **Study Nook** (17 items), **Cozy Kitchen** (22), **Messy Bedroom** (26). All items and rooms are built procedurally from three.js primitives with a cel-shaded, outlined look, so there are no model or texture files.

## Run it locally

Needs Node.js 20 or newer.

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Then open http://localhost:5173. (On this PC, PowerShell blocks plain `npm`; use `npm.cmd run dev`.)

| Command           | What it does                                                     |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `npm run dev`     | Dev server with hot reload                                       |
| `npm test`        | Rule tests, plus a solver that proves every level can be won     |
| `npm run build`   | Type-check and build the static site into `dist/`                |
| `npm run preview` | Serve the built `dist/` locally                                  |

URL options:

- `?level=2` opens level 2 directly (skips the menu).
- `?unlock` unlocks every level in the menu.

## Project layout

| Path                    | What's there                                                         |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src/game/logic.ts`     | The rules (no rendering), the solver and a casual-player simulation  |
| `src/game/levels.ts`    | Level data: categories in order, and where each item sits            |
| `src/scene/models.ts`   | The 58 item models                                                   |
| `src/scene/rooms.ts`    | Room furniture and the surfaces items rest on                        |
| `src/scene/stage.ts`    | Camera framing, picking and 3D animation                             |
| `src/scene/thumbs.ts`   | Renders each model to a small icon for the boxes and tray            |
| `src/ui/hud.ts`         | Boxes, tray, boosters, overlays                                      |
| `src/main.ts`           | Ties it together: input, event sequencing, menus                     |

To add a level, add a `LevelDef` to `src/game/levels.ts` (each item rests on a room `surface` or `on:` another item) and run `npm test`; it fails if the level can't be won.

## Deploy

Live at **https://huynx-tidy.vercel.app** (Vercel project `huy-nx/huynx-tidy`).

Source: https://github.com/Xuanhuy39/tidy. The repo is connected to the Vercel project, so every push to `main` deploys to production and every other branch gets a preview URL. [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs the tests and build on GitHub as a check.

Manual deploy from this folder: `vercel deploy --prod --scope huy-nx`.

`npm run build` also produces a plain static site in `dist/` with relative paths, so it can be hosted anywhere.

# polytopia-ai

A long-term build of an AI "wartime general" for The Battle of Polytopia. Claude is the general and Jason is the president. The goal is to **win, with combat first**; score doesn't matter.

**Current phase: Phase 1, data and verification.** No advisor or search work starts until the Phase 1 exit gates pass (`docs/polytopia_ai_phase_1_spec.md`).

## What's here

| Folder | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.scratchpad/` | Working notes for Claude Code sessions: current status, open work with owners, engine lessons, and one file per open mismatch hunt. Start with `.scratchpad/README.md`. |
| `engine/` | Replay engine: a Python copy of the game rules that replays a real save's action log and checks every unit's HP and position against the game's own end state. `replay.py` (rules and replay), `economy.py` (stars and income check), `state.py` (game state from a save), `stats.py` (unit stats). |
| `verify/` | Save decoder for game v123 (`state_v123.py`), save ingest (`ingest_saves.py`), the evidence **ledger** (`ledger.json`: every rule with its source and evidence level), and the Polyfish cross-check plus map analysis tools. `state2json/` and `statedebug/` are Go tools (binaries not committed; `go build` them). |
| `data/` | Rules dataset (units, tech tree, combat, economy, map generation, fog, tribes), measured tables from real saves (`measured_*.json`), and `conflicts_and_gaps.md` (every open conflict C1–C29 and gap G1–G12). |
| `saves_raw/` | The raw iPhone `.state` saves (95 files, 2.4 MB), committed. `sh scripts/restore_saves.sh` rebuilds `saves/` from them in about 8 seconds. |
| `tools/` | Small debug tools: `miss.py` (replay score), `trace.py` (one spot), `ledger.py` (edit the ledger without reading it), `outline.py` (find lines in big files). |
| `saves/` | **Local only, not committed** (gitignored); `scripts/check.sh` needs it. Real iPhone `.state` saves from 32 games (plus per-turn copies), their decoded JSON and `index.json`. Includes the bot war (`6e1bf8e0…` at turns 5/11/15), Ankiian turn by turn (`1bf60251…_t1`–`_t7`) and The Misty Fields turn by turn (`e15f392c…_t1`–`_t16`). `public_game_links.tsv` is Polyfish's list of ~11.7k public share links. |
| `sim/` | Map generator from the wiki rules (`wiki_mapgen.py`, with measured mode) and `pfcore/`, the Polyfish Rust engine core (Apache-2.0). |
| `notebook/` | `polytopia_engine.ipynb`, a self-contained Google Colab notebook (built by `build_notebook.py`). |
| `docs/` | Markdown exports of the Claude Docs: Phase 1 spec, roadmap, the in-game test sheet, plus `verify_tools.md`. |
| `legacy/` | Dataset v0.3 snapshot and the first map models (`polymap.py`, `hidden_tiles.py`, out of date). |
| `scripts/` | `check.sh` (smoke test), `fetch_third_party.sh` (re-clone reference repos into `ext/`), `run_notebook.py` (run the notebook headless). |

## Quick start

```sh
python3 -m pip install matplotlib        # only the notebook/map plots need it; the engine is pure stdlib
sh scripts/check.sh                      # replays both games and prints match scores
```

Expected from `check.sh` (the current baseline):

- Ankiian turn by turn: 27/27, 33/33, 39/39, 43/43, 51/51, 59/59, 66/66 units with exact HP.
- Bot war: turn 5 66/66, turn 11 92/92, turn 15 123/123: every unit exact.
- Misty Fields turn by turn (turns 1-16): exact through turn 12 (24, 29, 34, 37, 48, 69, 80, 94, 100, 103, 119, 123); then 133, 144, 149, 157: every unit exact.
- Oasis Struggle turn by turn (`af181c8f…_t1`–`_t26`, no t11/t17): see `data/conflicts_and_gaps.md` (full replay 2252 exact over 24 checkpoints).
- Cliff & Gods turn by turn (`09a5bf1e…_t1`–`_t8`, Crazy, 16 players): 26, 33, 47, 63, 78, 91, 109: every unit exact.
- Stars (`engine/economy.py`, last block of `check.sh`): Ankiian 96/96, bot war 18/32 (saves 4-6 turns apart), Misty Fields 239/240, Cliff & Gods 96/96 player-turns exact.

Replay one game by hand:

```sh
cd engine
python3 replay.py ../saves/<id>_t15.json ../saves/<id>_t5.json ../saves/<id>_t11.json   # final save, then checkpoints
```

Add a new save from the iPhone (the text export: first line is the device path, then base64):

```sh
python3 -I verify/ingest_saves.py saves export.txt
```

Rebuild all save JSONs from the raw `.state` files: `python3 -I verify/ingest_saves.py saves saves/*.state`.

## Third-party code

Reference repos (Polyfish, PolyEnv/Tribes, save editors and others) are **not committed**. `scripts/fetch_third_party.sh` re-clones them into `ext/` at the commits used. See `THIRD_PARTY.md`.

## Live docs (claude.ai)

- Phase 1 spec: https://claude.ai/artifact/K9wQ2L9xnNqnaxfckBGcwp
- Roadmap: https://claude.ai/artifact/BRUwionha6Zkjd7fY5WaQz
- Test sheet: https://claude.ai/artifact/VdTo8Kw8UGqYRQfygEVS2s

The copies in `docs/` were exported on 23 Oct 2026.

xirtus/LatterDayGame.readme:
# Latter Day Game ### *Joseph Smith and the gathering of Zion* — a playable first build, illustrated production report, and open 3D character library A respectful, historically grounded game concept about **Joseph Smith**, the coming forth of the Book of Mormon, the gathering of Zion, and a speculative celestial continuation. The plan is written as a playable life: revelation and family, scripture and community, suffering and hope, rendered in a warm cel-shaded nineteenth-century world. This repository is the **backup, production packet, reusable character library, and a playable cel-shaded first build** of that plan. It is a work in progress — not a finished game, not a documentary, and not an official Church product. **Start here** - 🎮 **[Run the playable first build](game/README.md)** — the cel-shaded journey (serve locally; see below) - 📖 **[Read the illustrated report](index.html)** — 32 chapter treatments, casting, art direction, engineering, and sources (open locally) - 🧍 **[Browse the 3D character library](models/README.md)** — 19 characters, 23 rigged models, previews and download links - 🗂️ **[Read the model manifest](models/manifest.json)** — hashes, triangle counts, rigs, clips, and original filenames - ⬇️ **[Download the report ZIP](downloads/JosephSmith-Game-Report.zip)** — the whole packet in one file > GitHub displays `.html` files as source. Clone or download the repository and open `index.html` in a browser for the report, or serve the root and open `/game/` for the playable build. --- ## Playable first build

The plan has grown into a playable, cel-shaded first build in [`game/`](game/). It includes the **32 core chapters plus the eight-era Zion expansion** (40 chapters total), the historical cast, the plates and witnesses, chapter select, and the transition from nineteenth-century New York to Ohio, Missouri, Nauvoo, and beyond. Characters are the local Meshy models from this repository, converted to a four-band toon material at runtime. It is an early build: animation coverage is limited to the clips that exist in the GLBs, facial and finger performance is not rigged, and some crowd roles are explicitly provisional. The historical text, sources, and design notes live in the report. ### Run it locally The game loads models and chapter data with `fetch`, so it needs an HTTP server — opening `game/index.html` directly will not work. ```bash # from the repository root python3 -m http.server 8000 # then open http://localhost:8000/game/ ``` **Controls:** `W A S D` to walk · drag to look · `E` to interact · `J` for the journey/chapter view · `V` to toggle the free camera.

The Sacred Grove — spring 1820
Witnesses and the printed book — Fayette, 1829
The prebuilt game needs no install. The `package.json` and `tools/` scripts are included for development; see [`game/README.md`](game/README.md) for the asset pipeline and how the public `models/` paths are wired in. --- ## The 3D character library The `meshy/` exports have been de-duplicated, renamed, and organized into one folder per character. Every character has a **rigged, animated GLB** ready for Blender, Unity, Godot, Unreal, or three.js, plus the unrigged source and remesh stages used to make it.

AscendedTweaks/AscendedTweaks.readme:
# Ascended Tweaks

Open-source Windows tuning that previews every change and can undo everything.

## Download

**[Download AscendedTweaks.zip](https://github.com/AscendedTweaks/AscendedTweaks/releases/latest/download/AscendedTweaks.zip)** for Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045) or Windows 11, 64-bit.
The checksums are on the [latest release page](https://github.com/AscendedTweaks/AscendedTweaks/releases/latest).

1. Download `AscendedTweaks.zip` and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
2. Unzip it and start `AscendedTweaks.exe`. No administrator rights are needed to start.
3. Choose "Install (recommended)" or "Just try it (portable)". `START HERE.txt` explains install, undo and removal.

Optional check before starting (PowerShell): `Get-FileHash .\AscendedTweaks.zip -Algorithm SHA256`.
The hash must match the line in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## What you get

- **Undo everything.** Every change is backed up first and can be reset with one click.
- **Preview first.** You see every value before and after, nothing changes without your confirmation.
- **No telemetry.** The app sends nothing. It only goes online when you start a check yourself.
- **Open source.** Every tweak names its source, so you can check what it does.

## Why does Windows warn me?

The files are not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC". Check the hash as shown above,
then click "More info" > "Run anyway". You can also verify that the ZIP was built from this repository:

```
gh attestation verify AscendedTweaks.zip --repo AscendedTweaks/AscendedTweaks
```

Do not turn off Microsoft Defender or SmartScreen for this or any other app.

## What it does not do

Ascended Tweaks never turns off Defender, the firewall, UAC, SmartScreen or Windows Update. Deleted files and removed apps
cannot always be restored; the app says so before you confirm.

## Command line

```
ascendedtweaks-cli --list [--module PRIV] [--json]
ascendedtweaks-cli --apply PRIV-001,PRIV-013 [--dry-run]
ascendedtweaks-cli --revert PRIV-001 | --revert-all
```

## Build from source

Requires the .NET 8 SDK (see `global.json`).

```
dotnet build
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -File build.ps1
```

`build.ps1` is the quality gate (build without warnings, tests, catalog lint, contrast and format checks, package test).
`build.ps1 -Package` builds the finished folder and the ZIP. Details: `docs/BUILD.md`.

| Folder | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `src/` | The app, the helper for administrator changes, the command line and the tweak catalog |
| `tests/` | Automated tests |
| `tools/` | Build, release and catalog tools |
| `site/` | The project website |
| `docs/` | Design notes, sources and privacy |

## License

MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Not affiliated with Microsoft or any game publisher.

Play it here: (link coming soon)

## Controls

- **Left / Right arrows**: steer
- **Up arrow**: speed up
- **Down arrow**: brake
- **Space**: restart after a crash

## What's in it

- autos, cars in a few colours, and big red buses
- cows that wander across the road and turn around at the edges
- sidewalks with people walking up and down
- rooftops from above: houses with water tanks and stairs, apartments with rows of tanks and sometimes solar panels
- some of the traffic spawns right in your lane, so you can't just sit still
- traffic JAMs: a flashing "JAM AHEAD!" warning, then a wall of vehicles 3 rows deep with one gap that shifts each row. some of them honk. get through and you get +5, and the next gap is a bit smaller
- zebra crossings where people walk across. hit one and it's game over
- score and a km/h speedometer
- the game gets faster every time a vehicle goes past you

## How it's made

plain JavaScript and the HTML canvas. no game engine, no libraries. everything you see is drawn with code, just rectangles and circles.

made for Hack Club Mipmap.

## AI note

I built this with Claude (Anthropic) as a coding tutor. I typed most of the code myself, following its step-by-step guidance. Some larger parts (the 3-row jam, the zebra crossings, and finishing a few steps) were written by Claude.

## Run it locally

download the repo and open `index.html` in a browser. that's it.

tomaldridge12/wayfarer.desc: Paper 26.3 plugin: Terraria-style trophy banners, heads and relics per mob family
tomaldridge12/wayfarer.readme:
# Wayfarer

A Paper 26.3 plugin for a friends' Minecraft server: Terraria-style trophy progression.

Kill enough of a mob family (zombies, skeletons, spiders, creepers, endermen) and you earn its rewards, one ladder per family:

- **Banners** that, once placed, give everyone nearby bonus damage against that family and less damage from it.
- **Trophy heads** that show your live kill count when placed.
- **Relics**: a themed weapon and armour piece per family in two tiers, with a family edge, perks and exclusive enchants. Wear relic armour from four families for the Wayfarer set bonus. Relics are meant as a trade-off against netherite, not an upgrade.
- An all-mobs ladder topped by the Wayfarer's Blade.
- **Bosses**: nine bosses (23 variants) rated 1 to 5 stars, built only on the Paper API. They appear as rare biome spawns and
  as guardians of structures (pyramids, monuments, bastions, strongholds and more), fight with abilities and a second phase,
  and give everyone who helped their own loot: boss heads, materials, a boss ladder (banner, head, regalia), and rare
  Ascended relics and Legendaries.

Everything is tunable in `plugins/Wayfarer/banners.yml` and `plugins/Wayfarer/bosses.yml`. Commands live under `/mobbanners`
(`progress`, `claim`, and operator tools) and `/wayfarer boss` (operator tools: `spawn`, `spawnall`, `list`, `killall`, `defeat`).

## Optional plugins

- [ExcellentEnchants](https://modrinth.com/plugin/excellentenchants) (with NightCore) adds the relics' custom enchants; see
  [docs/wayfarer-relic-enchants.md](docs/wayfarer-relic-enchants.md) to make them exclusive.
- [packetevents](https://modrinth.com/plugin/packetevents) shows those enchants' descriptions in tooltips.

## Building and running

Needs JDK 25.

```bash
source scripts/env.sh        # puts Homebrew JDK 25 on PATH (edit for your machine)
./gradlew :plugin:build      # build and unit tests
scripts/dev.sh               # dev server in server/ with the plugin loaded
scripts/smoke.sh             # boots a throwaway server and checks the log (about a minute)
```

Nubles/OSRS-Codex-Nomad.readme:
# Codex Nomad A RuneLite plugin for ultimate ironmen. A UIM has no bank, so Nomad keeps the books a bank would: everything you carry and everywhere you have stashed things, how long each deathpile has left, what to fetch before a trip and where to fetch it, where to note and unnote, and guards against the misclicks that cost a UIM the most.

## What it does - **Inventory tooltips.** Hover an item in your inventory to see every other place you keep it: a deathpile, a STASH unit, the costume room or a coffer. - **Find.** Type any item into the search box at the top and Nomad lists every place you have it, carried or kept, with how many and how far away. - **Pack tab.** What you carry: inventory, worn items, looting bag and rune pouch, plus the herb sack, coal bag, gem bag, fish barrel, log basket, seed box, tackle box, huntsman's kit, forestry kit, chugging barrel, essence pouches, plank sack, bolt pouch, master scroll book, bow string spool and Dizana's quiver, with free slots, worth, and what a death right now would cost. An ultimate ironman keeps nothing on an unsafe death, Protect Item included, so everything counts; on other accounts the three (or four with Protect Item) items you would keep are shown by name. Whatever sits inside a bag, pouch or sack is counted as lost, since it goes with its container. Items you have not used for a while (*Dead weight after*, 3 hours by default) are marked so you know what could go into storage. - **Stores tab.** Every place you keep things: items you dropped, deathpiles with their timers, your deathbank, the costume room in your house, STASH units, the seed vault and anything else you put away. The tool leprechaun, the Blast Furnace, fossil storage, the vyre well, Elnock's impling gear, Annette's drift nets, the pickaxe statue and the Nightmare Zone, Blast Furnace, Miscellania, Last Man Standing and Scar essence mine coffers are read straight from the game, and your servant's moneybag (up to 3M coins) and the Shilo Village furnace coffer whenever you check them. Bert's Sandstorm in Yanille, the balloon log crates, the Forestry log storage, a decayed cannon waiting with Nulodion and a weapon frozen with Eyatlalli are filed from what the game says about them. The cape on your house's cape hanger is read when the house loads. Compost bins are read whenever you pass one, so you know where your finished compost and ultracompost wait, so they are always right without a visit. Each store remembers what it holds, when it was last seen, and whether the count is exact or estimated. - **The way back.** You respawn with nothing, so Nomad works out the quickest way back to your deathpile with what you have left: running, your spellbook's home teleport, or the nearest minigame teleport you have unlocked, each with its cooldown read from the game. It says so the moment you respawn, on the deathpile card and on the plaque: *Minigame teleport to Castle Wars, then 10 tiles*. - **Lost for good.** Every deathpile that ran out, deathbank a death wiped, dropped item that vanished and raid floor you walked away from goes into a ledger at the foot of the Stores tab: when, what, and what it was worth, with the lifetime total. - **Deathpiles that tell you when.** A deathpile lasts 60 minutes of logged-in time. Nomad counts it down, warns you in chat when it is close to gone (*Deathpile warning*, 10 minutes by default), and marks the tile on the world map. Each pile says how many slots picking it up takes, and when you lack the room, which of your cheapest things to drop first. - **Dropped items with a timer.** Drop something and Nomad keeps it in the Stores tab with the exact second it vanishes, which world it is on, a countdown on its tile, and a warning in chat before it goes (*Dropped item warning*, 30 seconds by default). - **Deaths, judged.** When you die, Nomad works out where your items went: kept, a deathpile on the floor, or a deathbank behind a boss (Zulrah, Vorkath, Hydra, Nightmare, Nex, the Theatre of Blood, the Tombs of Amascut, the Volcanic Mine and more), and files them there. Each deathbank says who holds it and the fee (Torfinn for 100k at Vorkath, free from Priestess Zul-Gwenwynig at Zulrah), and warns when you carry fewer coins than the fee. The deathbank count becomes exact as soon as you open the retrieval window. - **Trips tab.** Save what you are wearing and carrying as a trip. When you start it, Nomad shows what you still need and the stops to fetch it from, nearest store first, plus what you carry that the trip does not need. Potions and charged jewellery count dose for dose, so super restore(3)s stand in for (4)s. The next stop can be marked on the ground (*Mark the next stop*). If you use Codex Quartermaster, its kits appear here too: each supply ("200 hp of food") becomes the items you own that cover it, and whatever is still short asks for the best item of that kind. - **Notes and unnotes.** For any item, where to note or unnote it near you: the tool leprechaun, Piles, Phials, the Pollnivneach banknote merchant, Tiles, the Elder Chaos druid, or your house servant, with the cost. - **STASH reminders.** Emote clue items you carry are matched to the STASH units they belong in, so you can put them away and stop carrying them. - **Guards.** Hides *Destroy* on the looting bag wherever destroying it would delete what is inside: outside the Wilderness, in the Ferox Enclave and on the first two tiles past the ditch (*Looting bag Destroy*). Where *Destroy* does drop the contents, Nomad names the food and potions inside that would be lost, and *Sell* on items worth more than a set

Arash1Kazemi/void-runner.readme:
# VOID RUNNER

A vertical space shooter for the Arduino Mega: a 16 × 24 screen of single LEDs plus three
status bars, a 4 × 4 keypad of push buttons and four buzzers (lead, bass, rhythm guitar,
sound effects). Three phases, three bosses,
three ships. Design and rules: [docs/SPEC.md](docs/SPEC.md). Pictures and animations of the
real screens: [docs/media/](docs/media/).

## Run it in VS Code (Wokwi)

1. Open this folder in VS Code.
2. `F1` → **Wokwi: Select Config File** → choose the `wokwi.toml` in the project folder
   (not the one in `tests/stage0`).
3. `F1` → **Wokwi: Start Simulator** (the compiled program is in `build/`).
4. **Click an empty spot of the circuit**, then use the keyboard (English layout):

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| W A S D | move (tap = 1 pixel, hold = glide) |
| R | fire (tap = 1 bullet, hold = auto-fire) · OK in menus |
| Q | back · pause in the game |
| P | pause / continue |
| M | sound on/off (any screen) |
| B | brightness 100 / 50 / 20 % (any screen) |

After changing the code, run `build.cmd` (or tell Claude) and restart the simulator.

## Run it on wokwi.com

New **Arduino Mega** project → paste `void_runner/void_runner.ino` into `sketch.ino`, paste
`diagram.json`, and add the other files of `void_runner/` with the editor's
"Upload file(s)..." menu.

## Please test (full game)

| # | Check |
|---|---|
| 1 | Logo + melody, any key skips it; title screen; after 20 s untouched a **demo** plays (any key stops it) |
| 2 | Menu → **SHIP**: A/D shows BOLT, DART, TWIN (status bars = speed / ammo / fire); R takes one |
| 3 | Menu → **OPTS**: W/S pages LITE, SND, DIFF, TEST; A/D changes; TEST runs the LED test |
| 4 | **PLAY**: the phase number and name appear as still pages (ZONE 1, ROCK BELT, GO!); moving and firing feel right (tap / hold / R rules) |
| 5 | Status bars: red = wave progress → boss health, yellow = ammo (blinks when low), green = lives |
| 6 | Ammo crates and extra lives can be caught; a big rock breaks into two |
| 7 | "WARN" + blinking warning sign + siren, then the boss: WARDEN (phase 1), HUNTER (fast, dives at you), VOID KING (changes form at half health) |
| 8 | P pauses (score shown), P continues, Q quits |
| 9 | Game over: score, NEW record, BEST page shows it |
| 10 | Is NORMAL too hard or too easy? Is anything confusing on the small screen? |
| 11 | Simulation speed (the % next to the timer), and the Serial line after typing `!s` in the terminal: `frame work us=` (CPU time of one picture, must stay well below 20000) |

Note: Wokwi starts every simulation with an empty EEPROM, so the high score and settings are
kept while it runs but not after a restart (on a real Arduino they would stay).

## Tests

```bash
python tests/host/run_tests.py
```

Builds the real game code for the PC (MSYS2 `g++`) and runs `tests/host/*.txt`: the key
rules, every screen, and a whole game. `--balance` also lets the autopilot play 12 games per
difficulty without the shield. No Wokwi minutes needed.

Wokwi scenarios (use the free plan's CLI minutes): `tests/scenarios/stage1_check.yaml`
(logo, title, menu, global keys) and `tests/scenarios/playthrough.yaml` (whole game):

```bash
wokwi-cli --timeout 120000 --scenario tests/scenarios/playthrough.yaml .
```

Serial test commands (type them in the Wokwi terminal, always with `!`): `!d` screen as text ·
`!s` state · `!1` `!2` `!3` start at a phase · `!b` skip to the boss · `!w` beat the boss ·
`!i` shield · `!x` autopilot · `!f` fast mode · `!k` lose the last life.

## Tools

- `tools/gen_circuit.py` – generates `diagram.json` and `void_runner/pins.h`
- `tools/gen_font.py` – generates `void_runner/font.h` from ASCII-art letters
- `tools/draw_wiring.py` – draws `docs/media/wiring.png`, a simplified wiring diagram
- `tools/compose_music.py` – the in-game songs in a short note notation; writes them into
  `void_runner/tunes.h` (listen to them: `docs/media/music/`)
- `tools/render_dumps.py` – turns screen dumps into a PNG or an animated GIF
- `tools/media_record.script` – PC-harness script that records the clips in `docs/media/`
- `tools/led_style_preview.html` – compares LED colour styles with Wokwi's real LED part
- `tools/led_brightness_preview.html` – how bright a lit LED looks for different `gamma` values
- `tools/text_preview.html` – live comparison of scrolling text vs. still pages, the way Wokwi
  shows them (serve the project folder, e.g. `python -m http.server`, then open
  `/tools/text_preview.html`)

DontPanic345/sansfiat.readme:
# Sans Fiat

Prototypes for a hex 4X with no money: goods are physical and worth what people will trade for them.
Each folder stands alone. Live builds are on [GitHub Pages](https://dontpanic345.github.io/sansfiat/).

| Folder | What |
| --- | --- |
| [`engine/`](engine/) | The game: a Rust engine with a CLI and a wasm web front end. New work goes here. |
| [`poc/`](poc/) | The full proof of concept: pre-game economy, civs, scouts, armies, supply. |
| [`hex-economy/`](hex-economy/) | Pre-game only: clans, land, gatherings, tended grain. |
| [`hex4x/`](hex4x/) | Minimal turn-based hex 4X used as a base. |
| [`scout/`](scout/) | Hidden trail costs and scouting routes. |
| [`supply-lines/`](supply-lines/) | Units carrying food, resupply lines, forage and pillage. |
| [`paint-army/`](paint-army/) | Single-page territory-painting army experiments. |

The JS prototypes are plain ES modules: `npm start`, `npm test`, `npm run sim`.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Dt9fBnbtCbtmK3RhNBbY5m

Roam-limited land, cell division, and a stable fed band

A clan walks all its land each turn, so its land's total move cost is
capped by CLAN.roam: about six plains tiles, three of forest. Home steps
toward the centre of the land. A big clan divides like a cell: its land
splits in two halves and the daughter takes one. Clans fed between
stableAt and full hold steady instead of starving; only starving clans
move on or send daughters away.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Dt9fBnbtCbtmK3RhNBbY5m

Clan territories, temporary gatherings and tended grain

Clans hold connected land and forage it plus unclaimed neighbours, so
neighbours leave buffers. Hungry clans grow or shift their land a tile at
a time, or move wholesale; settled clans grow faster. Big clans bud off
small daughters.

Game breeds back slowly once hunted out. Pre-game markets are gatherings
that disperse when trade dies down. Grain on long-held land is tamed
toward domestication, and the game starts once there is a domesticated
hearth for each player. Players take those hearths; markets then form
across the map.

Adds Settled and Tended grain views.

# VONG ÂM — Tiếng Gọi Sau Cánh Cửa (prototype web)

Prototype kinh dị góc nhìn thứ nhất, Babylon.js + TypeScript + Vite. Âm thanh tổng hợp bằng Web Audio.
Texture tường/trần/gỗ/gạch/đất là ảnh thật CC0 từ Poly Haven (`public/textures`, xem `CREDITS.txt`);
còn lại (gạch bông, câu đối, bùa, di ảnh, hình nhân...) vẽ bằng Canvas.

## Chạy

```bash
npm install
npm run dev        # mở http://localhost:5173
npm run build      # bản build tĩnh trong dist/
npm run play       # build rồi chạy bản gọn ở http://localhost:4173 (ổn định hơn bản dev)
npm run package    # build + nén thành vongam-web.zip để upload itch.io
npm run smoke      # kiểm thử khói: mở cả 6 chương, giải câu đố Đêm 1, sổ tay, đổi phím — dùng Chrome cài sẵn
```

Điều khiển (đổi được trong Cài đặt → Phím điều khiển): **WASD** di chuyển · **Shift** chạy · **E** tương tác / đóng giấy /
ra khỏi tủ · **F** đèn pin · **J** (hoặc Tab) sổ tay & tin nhắn · **H** gợi ý (trong sổ tay) · **M** tắt tiếng · **Esc** tạm dừng.

`npm run smoke` cần Google Chrome (đặt `CHROME_PATH` nếu Chrome không ở chỗ mặc định). Tài liệu thiết kế: [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md),
đánh giá kỹ thuật: [docs/AUDIT.md](docs/AUDIT.md), nhật ký sản xuất: [docs/PRODUCTION_LOG.md](docs/PRODUCTION_LOG.md).
Nên đeo tai nghe: tiếng gọi và tiếng gõ cửa là âm thanh 3D (HRTF).

Chơi liền mạch như một câu chuyện: màn hình chính chỉ có **Bắt đầu / Tiếp tục / Chơi lại từ đầu**. Mỗi đêm mở bằng
một **màn chuyển chương** (đoạn kể nối truyện, `intro` trong `src/core/levels.ts`); thắng thì "Tiếp tục — Đêm sau",
chết thì "Thử lại đêm này". Tiến trình lưu trong trình duyệt. Phá đảo (kết thúc thật của đêm cuối) mới mở mục
**Hồi tưởng** để chơi lại từng đêm. Thử nhanh một đêm: thêm `?dem=3` vào URL.



## Đợt sản xuất 2026-10: câu đố, sổ tay, điện thoại, tiếng sống

- **Câu đố hộp bánh quy (Đêm 1).** Chìa khóa phòng bà nằm trong hộp bánh quy bơ (đựng kim chỉ, như mọi nhà), quấn dây
  khóa xe đạp số. Mã = ngày giỗ ông theo âm lịch, ngày trước tháng sau. Manh mối: trang 2 lời bà dặn, tờ giấy hồng điều
  ghi ngày giỗ cạnh bàn thờ (chữ "Rằm" bị gạch), lịch bloc dưới bếp (Rằm tháng Bảy = 15/7). Đáp án **1607**. Mã gần
  đúng có câu phản hồi riêng; sai nhiều thì gợi ý rõ dần. Khóa số: A/D chọn vòng, W/S hoặc cuộn chuột xoay, gõ số trực tiếp, E kéo thử, Q thôi.
- **Sổ tay (J).** Ba trang: *Việc cần làm* (kèm gợi ý mở từng bậc bằng H — bậc cuối nói thẳng đáp án — và đồ đang mang
  theo, `data/items.json`), *Giấy tờ* (đọc lại mọi tờ giấy đã đọc trong đêm), *Tin nhắn*.
- **Điện thoại & nhóm Zalo "Gia đình họ Lâm"** (`data/messages.json`): cô Ba mê tín, dì Năm chuyển tiếp tin dây chuyền,
  chú Tư cụt lủn, mẹ đi làm ở Đài Loan. Điện thoại là giao diện "an toàn" cho tới khi nó bị chiếm: Zalo của bà đã mất
  (Đêm 1), chú Tư đếm (Chạng vạng), và một liên lạc tên **Út** — số của chính mình (Đêm cuối). Đêm 2, tin thật của mẹ
  tới đúng lúc "mẹ" gọi dưới giếng — bằng chứng để không trả lời.
- **Tiếng sống & sự im lặng** (`audio/Ambience.ts`): thạch sùng chặc lưỡi trong nhà, chó tru xa, xe máy chạy ngang
  ngoài đường. Khi căn nhà hết yên (gõ cửa, đi săn, mất điện), mọi tiếng sống tắt và đồng hồ quả lắc đứng giữa nhịp;
  thắp nhang xong thì thạch sùng kêu lại. Tiếng bước chân đổi theo mặt đất: gạch bông, xi măng ướt, bùn, đất, nước.
- **Cảnh hù mới (Đêm 1):** bóng đèn bếp vốn hay chập chờn (vô hại); đúng một lần, lúc nó giật, ngoài hành lang có người
  đứng nhìn vào qua khe cửa bếp — không có tiếng hù, chỉ có im lặng và câu tự trấn an.
- **Dễ chịu & trợ năng:** cảnh báo nội dung lần đầu chơi; *Giảm chớp & rung* (đèn chập chờn dịu đi, không rung camera,
  không chớp giao diện, không sét ở màn hình chính — mặc định theo `prefers-reduced-motion`); *Thời gian hiện chữ*
  (phụ đề, lời kể ×1 / ×1,5 / ×2); đổi phím; tắt tiếng nhanh (M); âm thanh tự ngắt khi chuyển tab.
- **Gói nhẹ hơn:** Babylon nhập theo đường dẫn sâu qua `src/babylon.ts` → gói chính 7,05 MB → 1,70 MB
  (gzip 1,56 MB → 415 KB); vào màn hình chính nhanh hơn ~45% (đo ở 9 Mbps). Mọi tệp phải nhập Babylon từ `src/babylon.ts`.
- Sửa cốt truyện: Út tuổi Mậu Dần (không phải Mậu Thìn); lời kết thật khớp với di vật (bà ẵm đứa *biết khóc*).

## Độ khó & cơ chế sinh tồn

- **Thể lực**: chạy ~5 giây thì hết hơi (không có thanh hiển thị — nghe tiếng thở dốc, viền màn hình tối lại).
  Hết hơi: không chạy được, tiếng thở thành tiếng động thực thể nghe thấy ở gần. Nghỉ ~2 giây mới chạy lại.
- **Nín thở trong tủ**: khi Người Gõ Cửa đứng nghe ngoài cửa tủ, giữ `Space`. Không nín quá 1,2 giây → nó nghe thấy;
  nín quá lâu (Dễ 11s / Thường 8s / Khó 6,5s) → sặc → bị lôi ra.
- **Độ khó** (Cài đặt): hệ số trong `src/core/difficulty.ts` cho tốc độ/tầm nhìn/tầm nghe của thực thể, tốc độ hình nhân,
  thể lực, thời gian nín thở. Tốc độ đuổi mặc định 3,1 m/s.
- **Giấy**: 5 chất liệu (`paper` trong `data/notes.json`: school vở ô li mực tím, diary sổ tay kẻ dòng, pencil bút chì,
  do giấy dó có dấu mộc, burnt cháy xém), mép rách bằng bộ lọc SVG, chia trang (`pages`, lật bằng A/D hoặc ←/→),
  `[[...]]` = dòng mực đỏ tự viết thêm sau ~3 giây đọc (kèm tiếng thì thầm sát tai). Cài đặt "Chữ trên giấy: Chữ in" để dễ đọc.
- **Action kịch bản mới**: `door` (đóng/mở cửa — đóng sầm kêu to, HUD chớp), `objective` có `glitch` (dòng nhiệm vụ bị chiếm).

## Nhân vật, hình nhân, bàn thờ

- **Người Gõ Cửa** (`src/entity/Knocker.ts` + `src/world/sprites.ts`): ảnh "bà" mặc bộ bà ba hoa, tóc ướt, cắt từ
  `reference/concept/hanh-lang-thuc-the.png` (tách nền bằng `rembg` u2netp), đặt trên billboard trục Y, chân mờ vào khói
  ("ma không chân"). Nó lơ lửng nhẹ, thỉnh thoảng giật đầu; lúc đuổi thì chúi người về trước và di chuyển giật cục
  (cập nhật vị trí hình theo nhịp ~0,11 s). Cú hù áp đúng khuôn mặt ảnh vào giữa màn hình. Khi giả làm Út (Đêm cuối),
  nó dùng mô hình hình học, lúc bắt người thì lớp đó rơi ra.
- **Hình nhân giấy** (`buildPaperDoll` trong `src/entity/Effigy.ts`, texture ở `src/world/paperTextures.ts`): mô hình 3D
  kiểu trát giấy Hoa, có Kim Đồng, Ngọc Nữ và hình nhân thế mạng

# monkeyvinerush.com

The website for **Monkey Vine Rush**, a game by Jason Grimmitt (Grimmitt Games), served by GitHub Pages at https://monkeyvinerush.com.

The site comes in all 16 of the app's languages. English is at the root (`/`, `/support/`, `/privacy/`) and each other language is under its code (`/es/`, `/es/support/`, ...).

## Editing

Don't edit the generated `index.html` files. Edit the sources in `src/`, then rebuild:

```
node src/build.js
```

- `src/home.html`, `src/support.html`, `src/privacy.html`: page templates; `{{key}}` marks text
- `src/i18n/<lang>.json`: the text for each language (`en.json` is the source)
- `src/build.js`: fills the templates, writes every language, the sitemap and robots.txt
- `assets/`: styles; `img/`: icon, screenshots, trailer and share image; `CNAME`: the domain

The old support and privacy pages in the `monkey-vine-rush-privacy` repo forward here.

# Strain Packs

A collectible strain-card and grow game. Open packs, collect strains, grow and harvest plants in an underground bunker, trim and cure the bud, and sell it in your shop. The whole game is **one HTML file**: open it in any browser (phone or computer) to play.

## Files

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `strain-packs.html` | **The main game.** Make changes here. Starts with 400 coins. |
| `strain-packs-test-kit.html` | Testing copy: 250,000 coins plus test tools (for example, force a God Pack). |
| `strain-packs-friends.html` | Friends test copy: starts with 3,000 coins. |

The three files are identical except for one line near the top of the script:

```js
/*BUILD*/const BUILD = {kind:"main", startCoins:400, badge:"", tools:false};/*END BUILD*/
```

The other two versions use `{kind:"test", startCoins:250000, badge:"TEST KIT", tools:true}` and `{kind:"friends", startCoins:3000, badge:"FRIENDS TEST", tools:false}`, and each has its own `<title>`. **Change only `strain-packs.html`**, then copy it over the other two and swap in that line and the title.

## Phone app (iPhone, Android, Samsung)

The `docs/` folder is the game as an installable phone app (a "home-screen app", also called a PWA). After it's put online, people open the link on their phone and add it to their home screen. It then opens full screen with its own icon and works with no signal.

- `docs/index.html` is the game page, built from `strain-packs.html`
- `docs/manifest.webmanifest` sets the app name, icon and full-screen mode
- `docs/sw.js` provides offline play
- `docs/icons/` holds the app icons

**After changing `strain-packs.html`, run `python3 build-app.py`** to rebuild `docs/index.html`. It also updates the version in `sw.js`, so installed phones get the new game next time they open it with signal.

How to install on a phone:
- **iPhone:** open the link in **Safari**, tap **Share**, then **Add to Home Screen**.
- **Android / Samsung:** open the link in **Chrome** or **Samsung Internet**, tap the menu (⋮ or ≡), then **Install app** or **Add to Home screen**.

## How the file is laid out

- **No `<html>`/`<head>`/`<body>` tags.** The file starts with `<title>` and `<style>`, followed by the page markup, then one big `<script>`.
- All the code is plain JavaScript inside one wrapper, `(() => { "use strict"; ... })()`. There are no libraries and no build step.
- About half the file size is pictures (packs, seed jars, the trim machine, coins and so on) stored inside the file as long `data:image/...;base64,` strings. Don't edit those; you can skip past them.
- Almost everything else (buds, plants, cards, the grower, the shop and customers) is drawn with canvas code.

The script is split into sections, each starting with a comment like `/* ---------- name ---------- */`. Search for these to find your way around:

| Section | What's in it |
|---|---|
| data | Strain list (`STRAINS`), rarities, packs, floors (`FLOORS`) |
| state | The save object `S` and `fresh()` |
| art / full-art backgrounds | Bud drawing, card art, a unique scene for each Mythical card |
| elevator / views | Floor navigation and `render()` |
| booster boxes, ripping a pack | Pack shop, opening packs, God Packs |
| trimming table, the trim machine | Benny the human trimmer and the conveyor trim machine |
| customer orders | Special orders |
| the till / what walk-in customers ask for | Counting change; gram, ounce and pound orders (`SIZES`, `makeOrder`, `fillOrder`) |
| staff (trimmer, grower, cashier) | Hired staff: Benny, the grower (Mari/Marco), Rico the cashier |
| the grower on screen / your grower's look | `drawMari()` draws every person in the game; grower clothes (`GLOOK`) |
| the shop floor / storefront | Animated shop: counter, scale, customers walking in (`paintShop`) |
| breeding rooms, sprays, pests, simulation | Growing logic |
| Grow Pass, Store, plant food, decorations, room looks | Shops and extras |
| friends / online now | Leaderboard, seed trading, grow-off, friends list |
| levels, actions | XP and the main click handler (buttons use `data-*` attributes) |
| plant drawing | Plants in the grow tents |
| saving, account, boot | Save and load, sign-in, start-up |

The screen is redrawn with `render()`. Animations run in `loop()` (requestAnimationFrame), and game logic ticks every 250 ms.

## Features that only work inside Claude

The game was built as a Claude artifact. These parts use Claude's built-in services (`window.claude`) and **do nothing when the file is opened anywhere else**:

- Signing in and saving to your account
- Who's online, friends, seed trading, the leaderboard and the grow-off

Opened anywhere else, the game still plays fully and saves on that device only (browser `localStorage`, key `strain-packs-save`).

## Tips for making changes

- Change one thing at a time, then open the file in a browser and check that it still loads.
- Before adding a CSS class, search the file to make sure the name isn't already used.
- Check it on a phone-sized screen too. The game is built to work on iPhone and Android.

dopg-vbee/bat-bai.readme:
# Bắt Bài 🎤

Game party chơi qua trình duyệt: nghe đoạn lời bài hát, đoán tên bài. Host chiếu màn hình lớn, người chơi dùng điện thoại quét QR là vào, không cần đăng nhập. Mỗi phòng chơi tốt với 60+ người.

## Luật chơi

1. Host vào **/admin**, chọn bộ đề, bấm **Tạo phòng chơi**. Màn hình lớn hiện QR và mã phòng 4 số.
2. Người chơi quét QR (hoặc vào trang chủ, nhập mã) rồi nhập tên.
3. Mỗi câu: đếm ngược 3 giây → **MP3 phát trên màn hình host** → người chơi gõ tên bài trên điện thoại.
   - Sai thì đoán lại được. Không cần gõ dấu, sai chính tả nhẹ vẫn tính, gõ thêm tên ca sĩ sau tên bài cũng tính. Đoán sát mà chưa đúng thì điện thoại báo **"Gần đúng rồi!"**.
   - Đúng càng nhanh càng nhiều điểm: **1000 → 500 điểm**.
   - **🔥 Chuỗi đúng:** từ câu đúng thứ 3 liên tiếp, avatar bốc cháy và mỗi câu được thưởng **+50**, tăng dần tới **+300** (chuỗi 8). Trượt một câu là mất chuỗi.
   - **⚡ Câu may mắn:** khoảng 1/5 số câu (không bao giờ là câu đầu) được chọn ngẫu nhiên tính **x2 điểm**. Chỉ lộ ra lúc đếm ngược câu đó.
   - **🎁 Hộp quà:** mỗi lần đoán đúng có 15% cơ hội được thưởng thêm ngẫu nhiên **+100 đến +300** điểm.
   - Ai đoán đúng thì avatar + tên bật lên màn hình lớn kèm tiếng "ting" (nhiều người đúng liên tiếp thì cao dần như chuỗi nốt nhạc).
4. Hết giờ (hoặc khi mọi người đều đúng): màn hình lớn hiện đáp án và phát đoạn YouTube cỡ lớn ở giữa màn hình. Phát xong tự chuyển sang **bảng xếp hạng** khoảng 5 giây (các dòng trượt tới hạng mới, điểm đếm tăng), rồi **tự sang câu tiếp**. Host bấm "Bỏ qua" / "Câu tiếp ngay" nếu muốn nhanh hơn.
   - Mỗi câu đặt được điểm **Phát từ** và **Đến**. Bỏ trống "Đến" thì phát 25 giây.
   - Nếu dán link có sẵn `?t=` (hoặc `start=`/`end=`), app tự điền hai ô này.
   - Ở trang quản lý bấm **▶ Xem trước đoạn YouTube** (trong form) hoặc **▶ YouTube 0:30 – 0:36** (ở từng câu) để nghe đúng đoạn đó.
5. Hết câu cuối sẽ hiện bục vinh danh top 3. Bằng điểm thì ai trả lời nhanh hơn (tổng thời gian) xếp trên.

**Chơi thử trước:** ở trang quản lý, nút **👁 Chơi thử** tạo một phòng y hệt ván thật, có 4 bot tự vào và tự đoán. Nút **👁 Xem thử** ở từng câu chỉ chạy riêng câu đó, để kiểm MP3 và đoạn YouTube. Trong phòng chơi thử có nút **📱 Mở màn hình người chơi**, mở cửa sổ cỡ điện thoại để tự đoán như người chơi.

**Chơi theo đội:** khi tạo phòng chọn **Chơi theo đội** (2–4 đội: Đỏ, Xanh, Vàng, Tím). Ở phòng chờ, màn hình lớn có một khung cho mỗi đội; người chơi tự chọn (và đổi) đội trên điện thoại, ai chưa chọn nằm ở khung "Chưa có đội". Chỉ bắt đầu được khi mọi người đều có đội; nút **Xếp đội ngẫu nhiên** chia lại tất cả cho đều. Ai vào sau khi game đã bắt đầu thì được xếp vào đội ít người nhất.
- **Điểm trung bình:** mọi người chơi như thường; điểm đội = trung bình điểm các thành viên (đội đông không có lợi thế). Bảng xếp hạng có thêm thanh điểm đội, cuối game có thẻ "Đội vô địch".
- **Đồng đội:** người đầu tiên trong đội đoán đúng là cả đội đúng, cùng nhận điểm đó. Bảng xếp hạng và bục vinh danh tính theo đội.

**Thả cảm xúc:** ai đoán đúng rồi (và cả lúc xem đáp án, bảng xếp hạng) có thanh 👍 ❤️ 😆 🔥 👏 😮 ở cuối màn hình điện thoại; bấm là emoji bật lên đâu đó dưới đáy màn hình lớn rồi bay lên, ẩn danh. Mỗi người tối đa 8 lần trong 2 giây.

**Điều khiển bằng điện thoại:** menu ☰ trên màn hình host → **Điều khiển bằng điện thoại** → quét mã QR. Điện thoại có các nút Bắt đầu / Hiện đáp án / Câu tiếp, Tạm dừng, Hiện mã QR vào phòng và Kết thúc. Ai quét mã này cũng điều khiển được phòng, nên mở nó khi người chơi không nhìn màn hình.

**Giao diện sáng/tối:** mặc định là tối. Bấm nút mặt trời/mặt trăng (trên thanh tiêu đề, hoặc góc trên bên phải ở trang chủ) để đổi. Mỗi máy tự nhớ lựa chọn của mình.

Người chơi rớt mạng hoặc khóa màn hình thì mở lại trang là vào tiếp, giữ nguyên điểm. Host có thể mời người chơi ra khỏi phòng (di chuột vào tên ở phòng chờ, bấm ×).

## Chạy trên máy

Cần Node.js 22.18 trở lên.

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm start            # http://localhost:3000, mật khẩu mặc định: batbai
```

- Đặt mật khẩu thật: copy `.env.example` thành `.env` và sửa `ADMIN_PASSWORD`.
- **Chơi trong mạng LAN** (laptop nối TV, mọi người dùng chung Wi-Fi): cứ mở `http://localhost:3000` trên laptop.
  - Mã QR tự trỏ sang IP Wi-Fi của máy, bỏ qua các card mạng ảo (Hyper-V, WSL, VPN…). Lúc khởi động, terminal cũng in dòng `Điện thoại vào: http://…`.
  - Điện thoại quét QR mà chỉ thấy **màn hình trắng hoặc đen, không tải được**: kiểm tra điện thoại có cùng Wi-Fi với laptop không. Sau đó kiểm tra tường lửa Windows có cho Node.js ở mạng **Private** không (Windows Security → Firewall → Allow an app → Node.js). Wi-Fi ở nhà nên đặt là Private.
  - Vẫn không được thì đặt `PUBLIC_URL=http://<IP-Wi-Fi>:3000` trong `.env`, QR sẽ dùng đúng địa chỉ đó.
- Khi phát triển: `npm run dev` (tự reload khi sửa code).

## Deploy online: Render + Cloudflare R2 (miễn phí)

App là **một service duy nhất** (web + realtime). Câu hỏi và MP3 lưu trên **Cloudflare R2**, nên server khởi động lại, deploy lại hay ngủ đông đều không mất dữ liệu.

### 1. Tạo kho lưu trữ R2

1. Đăng nhập [dash.cloudflare.com](https://dash.cloudflare.com) → **R2 Object Storage**. Cloudflare yêu cầu gắn thẻ hoặc PayPal để bật R2; dùng dưới 10GB thì không mất tiền.

keksfabian-jpg/Homebots.desc: Homefront multiplayer offline with bots - fan-made Rust/Bevy engine that loads the content from your own Homefront install
keksfabian-jpg/Homebots.readme:
# HomeBots **Homefront multiplayer – offline, with bots.** HomeBots is a fan-made re-implementation of Homefront's (2011) multiplayer in Rust with the Bevy engine. HomeBots makes the multiplayer maps playable offline, against and together with AI soldiers. It reads the maps, models, textures, materials, sounds, menus and texts directly from your installed copy of **Homefront** (Steam) – similar to how OpenMW works for Morrowind. This repository and the release contain **no game files**; you need your own Homefront installation. ![Calling in the nuke](docs/media/nuke-call.gif) ### What's in it - **Ground Control and Team Deathmatch** on the multiplayer maps, with bots on both teams that capture objectives, use vehicles, throw grenades and only react to what they can actually see - **Battle Points**: buy vehicles, drones and air strikes – the bots do it too - **Vehicles**: tanks, LAVs, Humvees, Apache and scout helicopters, with damage, wrecks and fires - **Drones and air strikes**: drones, Hellfire and bombing runs, used by players and bots - **Weather and a day/night cycle**: rain and snow (not under roofs), thunderstorms, night lighting - **End-of-match nuke**: shortly before a team wins the match, it gets a tactical nuke – Fulton pickup by a C-130, countdown, detonation, mushroom cloud and crater - Original menus, HUD, kill feed, loading screens and the game's own post-processing (eye adaptation, bloom)

## Download and play 1. Get `HomeBots.zip` from the [Releases](../../releases) page and unpack it anywhere. 2. Double-click `HomeBots.exe`. Homefront is expected at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\HOMEFRONT`. If it is installed elsewhere, put the path into `gamepath.txt` (one line without `#`) or set the environment variable `HOMEBOTS_GAME`. The language follows Homefront's language setting in Steam (the GIFs above show the German version). Controls are the original game's (Options > Controls); F1 opens a debug menu. ## Build from source Requires Rust (stable) on Windows. ```powershell cd HomeBots cargo run --release -p homebots ``` `tools\make_release.cmd` builds the release package into `dist\`. ## Crates - `crates/upk` – reader for UE3 packages (`.u`, `.upk`, `.map`; Homefront's version 576/100, LZO chunks), textures, meshes, materials, shader cache - `crates/upk-dump` – CLI that prints a package summary - `crates/homebots` – the game (Bevy 0.16) `MODLOG.md` is the (German) development log. ## Third-party content The nuke sequence uses external models and sounds; see `assets/nuke/CREDITS.txt` (CC BY 4.0 / Pixabay Content License). Homefront is a trademark of its respective owners. This is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.
